On the gengchen new moon of the twelfth month there was a total solar eclipse. On guiwei day Song again sent Cao Liyong, and because there was no intention to return territory, Supervisory Gate Guard General Yao Shuzhi was sent with a letter in reply. On wuzi day Song sent Li Jichang seeking peace, addressing the Empress Dowager as aunt and offering yearly payment of one hundred thousand taels of silver and two hundred thousand bolts of silk. Peace was granted, and Gate Commissioner Ding Zhen was immediately sent with a letter in reply. On jichou day an edict ordered all armies to stand down. That month the army withdrew. The Empress Dowager granted Grand Chancellor King of Qi Han Dechang the surname Yelü and transferred him to King of Jin. That year jinshi Li Kefeng and three others passed the examinations.

二十三年春正月戊午，還次南京。庚申，大饗將卒，爵賞有差。二月丙戌，復置榷場於振武軍。丁巳，夏國遣使告下宋青城。辛酉，朝皇太后。以惕隱化哥為南院大王，行軍都監老君奴為惕隱。乙丑，振党項部。丁卯，回鶻來貢。丁丑，改易州飛狐招安使為安撫使。夏四月丙戌，女直及阿薩蘭回鶻各遣使來貢。乙未，鐵驪來貢。己亥，党項來侵。五月戊申朔，宋遣孫僅等來賀皇太后生辰。乙卯，以金帛賜陣亡將士家。丙寅，高麗以與宋和，遣使來賀。六月壬辰，清暑炭山。甲午，阻卜酋鐵剌裏遣使賀與宋和。己亥，達旦國九部遣使來聘。秋七月癸丑，問安皇太后。戊午，党項來貢。辛酉，以青牛白馬祭天地。壬戌，烏古來貢。丁卯，女直遣使來貢。阿薩蘭回鶻遣使來請先留使者，皆遣之。九月甲戌，遣太尉阿裏、太傅楊六賀宋主生辰。冬十月丙子朔，鼻骨德來貢。戊子，朝皇太后。甲午，駐蹕七渡河。癸卯，宋歲幣始至，後為常。十一月戊申，上遣太保合住、頒給使韓橁，太后遣太師盆奴、政事舍人高正使宋賀正旦。辛亥，觀漁桑乾河。丁巳，詔大丞相耶律德昌出宮籍，屬於橫帳。十二月丙申，宋遣周漸等來賀千齡節。丁酉，復遣張若谷等來賀正旦。

In the twenty-third year, on wuwu day of the first spring month, the court returned and halted at Nanjing. On gengshen day a great feast was held for generals and soldiers, and ranks and rewards were granted in varying measure. On bingxu day of the second month the border market at Zhenwu Army was restored. On dingsi day Western Xia sent envoys reporting the capture of Song's Qingcheng. On xinyou day the court had audience with the Empress Dowager. Tiyin Huage was appointed Southern Court Great King, and mobile army supervisor Laojunnu was appointed tiyin. On yichou day the Tangut tribes were pacified. On dingmao day the Uyghur came with tribute. On dingchou day the Feihu recruitment-and-pacification commissioner of Yi Prefecture was changed to pacification commissioner. On bingxu day of the fourth summer month the Jurchen and Arsalan Uyghur each sent envoys with tribute. On yiwei day the Iron Li came with tribute. On jihai day the Tangut invaded. On the wushen new moon of the fifth month Song sent Sun Jin and others to congratulate the Empress Dowager's birthday. On yimao day gold and silk were granted to the families of soldiers killed in battle. On bingyin day Goryeo, because of peace with Song, sent envoys to offer congratulations. On renchen day of the sixth month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat. On jiawu day Zubu chief Tielili sent envoys congratulating the peace with Song. On jihai day the nine tribes of Dadan state sent envoys on a friendly visit. On guichou day of the seventh autumn month the court inquired after the Empress Dowager's health. On wuwu day the Tangut came with tribute. On xinyou day black ox and white horse were sacrificed to heaven and earth. On renxu day the Ugu came with tribute. On dingmao day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute. Arsalan Uyghur sent envoys requesting the release of previously detained envoys, and all were sent off. On jiaxu day of the ninth month Grand Commandant Ali and Grand Tutor Yang Liu were sent to congratulate the Song emperor's birthday. On the bingzi new moon of the tenth winter month the Bigud came with tribute. On wuzi day the court had audience with the Empress Dowager. On jiawu day the court halted at Qidu River. On guimao day Song's yearly tribute first arrived; afterward it became regular. On wushen day of the eleventh month the Emperor sent Grand Preceptor Hezhu and distribution commissioner Han Song, and the Empress Dowager sent Grand Preceptor Pannu and Secretariat drafter Gao Zheng to Song to congratulate the New Year. On xinhai day the court watched fishing on the Sanggan River. On dingsi day an edict ordered Grand Chancellor Yelü Dechang removed from the palace household registry and affiliated with the Horizontal Tents. On bingshen day of the twelfth month Song sent Zhou Jian and others to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival. On dingyou day Song again sent Zhang Ruogu and others to congratulate the New Year.

二十四年春正月，如鴛鴦濼。夏五月壬寅朔，幸炭山清暑。幽皇太妃胡輦於懷州，囚夫人夷懶於南京，餘黨皆生瘞之。秋七月辛丑朔，南幸。八月丙戌，改南京宮宣教門為元和，外三門為南端，左掖門為萬春，右掖門為千秋。是月，沙州敦煌王曹壽遣使進大食國馬及美玉，以對衣、銀器等物賜之。九月，幸南京。冬十月庚午朔，帝率群臣上皇太后尊號曰睿德神略應運啟化承天皇太后，群臣上皇帝尊號曰至德廣孝昭聖天輔皇帝。大赦。是年，放進士楊佶等二十三人及第。

In the twenty-fourth year, in the first spring month, the court went to Yuanyang Marsh. On the renyin new moon of the fifth summer month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat. Imperial Consort Hu of You was buried alive at Huaizhou, Lady Yilan was imprisoned at Nanjing, and all remaining conspirators were buried alive. On the xinchou new moon of the seventh autumn month the court made a southern tour. On bingxu day of the eighth month Nanjing Palace's Xuanjiao Gate was renamed Yuanhe, the outer three gates Nanduan, the left side gate Wanchun, and the right side gate Qianqiu. That month Shazhou Dunhuang King Cao Shou sent envoys presenting Arabian horses and fine jade, and paired robes, silver vessels, and other items were granted in return. In the ninth month the court visited Nanjing. On the gengwu new moon of the tenth winter month the Emperor led the officials in bestowing on the Empress Dowager the honorific Sage Virtue, Divine Strategy, Responsive Fortune, Initiating Transformation, and Sustaining Heaven Empress Dowager, and the officials bestowed on the Emperor the honorific Utmost Virtue, Broad Filiality, Illustrious Sagacity, Heaven-Assisted Emperor. A general amnesty was proclaimed. That year jinshi Yang Ji and twenty-three others passed the examinations.
二十五年春正月，建中京。二月，如鴛鴦濼。夏四月，清暑炭山。六月，賜皇太妃胡輦死於幽所。秋七月壬申，西平王李德昭母薨，遣使吊祭。甲戌，遣使起復。九月，西北路招討使蕭圖玉討阻卜，破之。冬十月丙申，駐蹕中京。十二月乙酉，振饒州饑民。

In the twenty-fifth year, in the first spring month, the Central Capital was built. In the second month the court went to Yuanyang Marsh. In the fourth summer month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat. In the sixth month Imperial Consort Hu was granted death at her place of confinement. On renshen day of the seventh autumn month the mother of King of Xiping Li Dezhao died, and envoys were sent to mourn and sacrifice. On jiaxu day envoys were sent to recall him from mourning. In the ninth month Northwestern Road pacification commissioner Xiao Tuyu attacked the Zubu and defeated them. On bingshen day of the tenth winter month the court halted at the Central Capital. On yiyou day of the twelfth month famine victims of Raozhou were relieved.
二十六年春二月，如長濼。夏四月辛卯朔，祠木葉山。五月庚申朔，還上京。丙寅，高麗進龍須草席。己巳，遣使賀中京成。庚午，致祭祖、懷二陵。辛未，駐蹕懷州。秋七月，增太祖、太宗、讓國皇帝、世宗謚，仍謚皇太弟李胡曰欽順皇帝。冬十月戊子朔，幸中京。十二月，蕭圖玉奏討甘州回鶻，降其王耶剌裏，撫慰而還。是年，放進士史克忠等一十三人。

In the twenty-sixth year, in the second spring month, the court went to Chang Marsh. On the xinmao new moon of the fourth summer month sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye. On the gengshen new moon of the fifth month the court returned to the Upper Capital. On bingyin day Goryeo presented dragon-whisker grass mats. On jisi day envoys were sent to congratulate the completion of the Central Capital. On gengwu day the court offered sacrifice at the Zu and Huai mausoleums. On xinwei day the court encamped at Huaizhou. In the seventh autumn month the posthumous titles of Emperor Taizu, Emperor Taizong, the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm, and Emperor Shizong were augmented; Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu was also posthumously titled Emperor Qinshun. On the wuzi new moon of the tenth winter month the court visited the Central Capital. In the twelfth month Xiao Tuyu reported a campaign against the Ganzhou Uighurs, subdued their king Yelali, reassured the people, and returned. That year Shi Kezhong and twelve others passed the examinations.
二十七年春正月，鉤魚土河。獵於瑞鹿原。夏四月丙戌朔，駐蹕中京，營建宮室。庚戌，廢霸州處置司。秋七月甲寅朔，霖雨，潢、土、斡剌、陰涼四河皆溢，漂沒民舍。八月甲申，北幸。冬十一月壬子朔，行柴冊禮。十二月乙酉，南幸。皇太后不豫。戊子，肆赦。辛卯，皇太后崩於行宮。壬辰，遣使報哀於宋、夏、高麗。戊申，如中京。己酉，詔免賀千齡節。是歲，御前引試劉二宜等三人。

In the twenty-seventh year, in the first spring month, the court went ice fishing on the Tu River. The court hunted at Ruilu Plain. On the bingxu new moon of the fourth summer month the court encamped at the Central Capital and began building palace halls. On gengxu day the Bazhou disposition office was abolished. On the jiayin new moon of the seventh autumn month heavy rains caused the Huang, Tu, Wala, and Yinliang rivers to overflow and wash away civilian dwellings. On jiashen day of the eighth month the court made a northern tour. On the renzi new moon of the eleventh winter month the firewood-and-script rites were performed. On yiyou day of the twelfth month the court made a southern tour. The Empress Dowager fell ill. On wuzi day a general amnesty was proclaimed. On xinmao day the Empress Dowager died at the traveling palace. On renchen day envoys were sent to announce the mourning to Song, Western Xia, and Goryeo. On wushen day the court went to the Central Capital. On jiyou day an edict canceled observance of the Thousand Age Festival. That year Liu Eryi and two others passed the imperial preliminary examination.
015: 二十八年春正月辛亥朔，不受賀。甲寅，如乾陵。癸酉，奉安大行皇太后梓宮於乾州菆塗殿。二月丙戌，宋遣王隨、王儒等來吊祭。己亥，高麗遣魏守愚等來祭。是月，遣左龍虎衛上將軍蕭合卓饋大行皇太后遺物於宋，仍遣臨海軍節度使蕭虛列、左領軍衛上將軍張崇濟謝宋吊祭。三月癸卯，上大行皇太后謚為聖神宣獻皇后。是月，宋、高麗遣使來會葬。夏四月甲子，葬太后於乾陵。賜大丞相耶律德昌名曰隆運。庚午，賜宅及陪葬地。五月己卯朔，如中京。辛卯，清暑七金山。乙巳，西北路招討使蕭圖玉奏伐甘州回鶻，破蕭州，盡俘其民。詔修土隗口故城以實之。丙午，高麗西京留守康肇弒其主誦，擅立誦從兄詢，詔諸道繕甲兵，以備東征。秋八月戊申，振平州饑民。辛亥，幸中京。丙寅，謁顯、乾二陵。丁卯，自將伐高麗，遣使報宋。以皇弟楚國王隆祐留守京師，北府宰相、駙馬都尉蕭排押為都統，北面林牙僧奴為都監。九月乙酉，遣使冊西平王李德昭為夏國王。辛卯，遣樞密直學士高正、引進使韓杞宣問高麗王詢。冬十月丙午朔，女直進良馬萬匹，乞從征高麗，許之。王詢遣使奉表乞罷師，不許。十一月乙酉，大軍渡鴨淥江，康肇拒戰，敗之，退保銅州。丙戌，肇復出，右皮室詳穩耶律敵魯擒肇及副將李立，追殺數十里，獲所棄糧餉、鎧仗。戊子，銅、霍、貴、寧等州皆降。排押至奴古達嶺，遇敵兵，戰敗之。辛卯，王詢遣使上表請朝，許之。禁軍士俘掠。以政事舍人馬保佑為開京留守，安州團練使王八為副留守。遣太子太師乙凜將騎兵一千，送保佑等赴京。壬辰，守將卓思正殺遼使者韓喜孫等十人，領兵出拒，保佑等還。遣乙凜領兵擊之，思正遂奔西京。圍之，五日不克。駐蹕城西。高麗禮部郎中渤海陀失來降。庚子，遣排押、盆奴等攻開京，遇高麗兵，敗之。王詢棄城遁去，遂焚開京，至清江，還。

In the twenty-eighth year of Tonghe, on the xinhai new moon of the first spring month the court declined congratulatory rites. On jiayin day the Emperor went to Qian Mausoleum. On guiyou day the late Empress Dowager's coffin was enshrined at the Temporary Enclosure Hall in Qian Prefecture. On bingxu day of the second month Song sent Wang Sui, Wang Ru, and others to offer mourning sacrifices. On jihai day Goryeo sent Wei Shouyu and others to present offerings. That month Left Dragon-Tiger Guard senior general Xiao Hezhuo was sent with the late Empress Dowager's belongings to Song, while Linhai Army military commissioner Xiao Xulie and Left Leading Army Guard senior general Zhang Chongji were dispatched to thank Song for its mourning envoys. On guimao day of the third month the late Empress Dowager was given the posthumous title Empress Shenshen Xuanxian. That month Song and Goryeo sent envoys to attend the burial. On jiazi day of the fourth summer month the Empress Dowager was buried at Qian Mausoleum. Grand Chancellor Yelü Dechang was granted the name Longyun. On gengwu day he was granted a residence and land for burial accompaniment. On the jimao new moon of the fifth month the court went to the Central Capital. On xinmao day the court took the summer retreat at Qijin Mountain. On yisi day Northwestern Pacification commissioner Xiao Tuyu reported an attack on the Ganzhou Uyghur in which Xiaozhou was taken and its entire population captured. An edict ordered the old city at Turuikou repaired and populated. On bingwu day Goryeo Western Capital governor Kang Zhao murdered King Song and installed Song's cousin King Xun without authorization; an edict ordered all circuits to ready arms for an eastern expedition. On wushen day in the eighth autumn month famine relief was distributed at Ping Prefecture. On xinhai day the court visited the Central Capital. On bingyin day the Emperor visited the Xian and Qian mausoleums. On dingmao day the Emperor personally led a campaign against Goryeo and sent envoys to inform Song. Prince of Chu Longyou was left to guard the capital; Northern Chancellery chancellor and imperial son-in-law Xiao Paia was made supreme commander, and Northern Privy Chancellor Sengnu inspector general. On yiyou day of the ninth month envoys were sent to invest Western Peace King Li Dezhao as King of Xia. On xinmao day Privy Direct Academician Gao Zheng and Introducing Commissioner Han Qi were dispatched to question Goryeo King Xun. On the bingwu new moon of the tenth winter month the Jurchen presented ten thousand fine horses and asked to join the Goryeo campaign; permission was granted. King Xun sent envoys begging the army be withdrawn; the request was refused. On yiyou day of the eleventh month the main army crossed the Yalu River; Kang Zhao offered battle, was defeated, and fell back to defend Tong Prefecture. On bingxu day Kang Zhao sallied forth again; Right Pishi xiangwen Yelü Dilu captured him and vice general Li Li, pursued the enemy for several tens of li, and seized abandoned provisions, armor, and weapons. On wuzi day Tong, Huo, Gui, Ning, and other prefectures all surrendered. Xiao Paia reached Nuguda Ridge, met enemy forces, and defeated them in battle. On xinmao day King Xun sent envoys requesting an audience; the request was granted. Soldiers were forbidden to plunder captives. Administrative Clerk Ma Baoyou was made Kaegyeong garrison commander and An Prefecture regiment trainer Wang Ba vice garrison commander. Crown Prince Grand Tutor Yi Lin was sent with one thousand cavalry to escort Baoyou and the others to the capital. On renchen day garrison commander Zhuo Sizheng killed Liao envoys Han Xisun and ten others and led troops out to resist; Baoyou and the others withdrew. Yi Lin was dispatched to attack him with troops; Sizheng then fled to the Western Capital. The city was besieged for five days without being taken. The court encamped west of the city. Bohai Tuoshi, a middle-rank official of Goryeo's Ministry of Rites, came over and surrendered. On gengzi day Xiao Paia, Penu, and others were sent to attack Kaegyeong, met Goryeo troops, and defeated them. King Xun abandoned the city and fled; Kaegyeong was then burned, and the army reached Qing River before turning back.

二十九年春正月乙亥朔，班師，所降諸城復叛。至貴州南峻嶺谷，大雨連日，馬駝皆疲，甲仗多遺棄，霽乃得渡。己丑，次鴨淥江。庚寅，皇后及皇弟楚國王隆祐迎於來遠城。壬辰，詔罷諸軍。己亥，次東京。二月己酉，謁乾、顯二陵。戊午，所俘高麗人分置諸陵廟，餘賜內戚、大臣。三月己卯，大丞相晉國王耶律隆運薨。庚辰，皇弟楚國王隆祐權知北院樞密使事，樞密直學士高正為北院樞密副使。庚寅，南京、平州水，振之。己亥，以北院大王耶律室魯為北院樞密使，封韓王，北院郎君耶律世良為北院大王，前三司使劉慎行參知政事兼知南院樞密使事。夏四月，清暑老古堝。五月甲戌朔，詔已奏之事送所司附日曆。又詔帳族有罪，黥墨依諸部人例。乙未，以劉慎行為南院樞密使，南府宰相邢抱質知南院樞密使事。六月庚戌，升蔚州、利州為觀察使。乙卯，韓王耶律室魯薨。丙辰，以南院大王化哥為北院樞密使。丁巳，詔西北路招討使、駙馬都尉蕭圖玉安撫西鄙。置阻卜諸部節度使。是秋，獵於平地松林。冬十月庚子朔，駐蹕廣平澱。甲寅，贈大丞相晉國王耶律隆運尚書令，謚文忠。十一月庚午朔，幸顯州。十二月庚子朔，復如廣平澱。癸丑，以知南院樞密使事邢抱質年老，詔乘小車入朝。是月，置歸、寧二州。是年，禦試，放高承顏等二人及第。

In the twenty-ninth year, on the yihai new moon of the first spring month the army withdrew; the cities that had surrendered all rebelled again. At Nanjun Ridge valley south of Gui Prefecture it rained heavily for many days; horses and camels were exhausted and much armor and equipment was abandoned before the army could cross once the weather cleared. On jichou day the army halted at the Yalu River. On gengyin day the Empress and Prince of Chu Longyou welcomed the court at Laiyuan City. On renchen day an edict ordered all armies disbanded. On jihai day the court halted at the Eastern Capital. On jiyou day of the second month the Emperor visited the Qian and Xian mausoleums. On wuwu day captured Goryeo people were assigned to the various mausoleum temples, and the remainder were granted to imperial in-laws and senior ministers. On jimao day of the third month Grand Chancellor King of Jin Yelü Longyun died. On gengchen day Prince of Chu Longyou was made provisional Northern Privy Commissioner and Privy Direct Academician Gao Zheng Northern Privy Vice Commissioner. On gengyin day flooding at Nanjing and Ping Prefecture was met with relief. On jihai day Northern Chancellery Great King Yelü Shilu was appointed Northern Privy Commissioner and enfeoffed King of Han; Northern Chancellery langjun Yelü Shiliang was made Northern Chancellery Great King; and former Three Departments commissioner Liu Shenxing was appointed associate administrative affairs commissioner and concurrent Southern Privy Commissioner. In the fourth summer month the court took the summer retreat at Laogu Marsh. On the jiaxu new moon of the fifth month an edict ordered matters already submitted to the relevant offices to be appended to the court calendar. An edict also ordered that guilty members of tent clans be tattooed according to tribal precedent. On yiwei day Liu Shenxing was appointed Southern Privy Commissioner and Southern Chancellery chancellor Xing Baozhi was assigned to manage Southern Privy Commissioner affairs. On gengxu day of the sixth month Wei Prefecture and Li Prefecture were elevated to observation commissions. On yimao day King of Han Yelü Shilu died. On bingchen day Southern Chancellery Great King Huage was appointed Northern Privy Commissioner. On dingji day an edict ordered Northwestern Pacification commissioner and imperial son-in-law Xiao Tuyu to pacify the western frontier. Military commissioners were established for the various Zubu tribes. That autumn the court hunted at Pingdi Songlin. On the gengzi new moon of the tenth winter month the court encamped at Guangping Marsh. On jiayin day Grand Chancellor King of Jin Yelü Longyun was posthumously made Palace Secretary and given the posthumous title Wenzhong. On the gengwu new moon of the eleventh month the court visited Xian Prefecture. On the gengzi new moon of the twelfth month the court again went to Guangping Marsh. On guichou day, because Xing Baozhi, who managed Southern Privy Commissioner affairs, was advanced in years, an edict allowed him to attend court in a small cart. That month Gui and Ning Prefectures were established. That year Gao Chengyan and two others passed the palace examination.

開泰元年春正月己巳朔，宋遣趙湘、符成翰來賀。癸未，長白山三十部女直酋長來貢，乞授爵秩。甲申，駐蹕王子院。丙戌，望祠木葉山。丁亥，女直太保蒲撚等來朝。戊子，獵於買曷魯林。庚寅，祠木葉山。辛卯，曷蘇館大王曷裏喜來朝。二月壬子，駐蹕瑞鹿原。三月甲戌，以蔚州為觀察，不隸武定軍。乙亥，如葦濼。丁丑，詔封皇女八人為郡主。乙酉，詔卜日行拜山、大射柳之禮，命北宰相、駙馬、蘭陵郡王蕭寧，樞密使、司空邢抱質督有司具儀物。丁亥，皇弟楚國王隆祐徙封齊國王，留守東京。夏四月庚子，高麗遣蔡忠順來，乞稱臣如舊，詔王詢親朝。壬寅，夏國遣使進良馬。己酉，祀風伯。辛酉，以前孟父房敞穩蕭佛奴為左夷離畢。五月戊辰朔，還上京。詔裴玄感、邢祥知禮部貢舉，放進士史簡等十九人及第。以駙馬蕭紹宗為鄭州防禦使。乙亥，以邢抱質為大同軍節度使。六月，駐蹕上京。秋七月丙子，以耶律遂貞為遼興軍節度使，遂正北院宣徽使，張昭瑩南院宣徽使，耶律受益上京副留守，寇卿彰德軍節度使。命耶律釋身奴、李操充賀宋國生辰信使副，蕭涅袞、齊泰賀宋正旦使副。進士康文昭、張素臣、郎玄達坐論知貢舉裴玄感、邢祥私曲，秘書省正字李萬上書，辭涉怨訕，皆杖而徒之，萬役陷河冶。八月丙申朔，鐵驪那沙等送兀惹百餘戶至賓州，賜絲絹。是日，那沙乞賜佛像、儒書，詔賜《護國仁王佛像》一，《易》、《詩》、《書》、《春秋》、《禮記》各一部。己未，高麗王詢遣田拱之奉表，稱病不能朝，詔復取六州地。是月，齊國王隆祐薨，輟朝五日。冬十月辛亥，如中京。閏月丁卯，贈隆祐守太師，謚仁孝。十一月甲午朔，文武百官加上尊號曰弘文宣武尊道至德崇仁廣孝聰睿昭聖神贊天輔皇帝。大赦，改元開泰。改幽都府為析津府，薊北縣為析津縣，幽都縣為宛平縣，覃恩中外。己亥，賜夏國使、東頭供奉官曹文斌、呂文貴、竇珪祐、守榮、武元正等爵有差。癸卯，前遼州錄事張庭美六世同居，儀坤州劉興胤四世同居，各給復三年。甲辰，西北招討使蕭圖玉奏七部太師阿裏底因其部民之怨，殺本部節度使霸暗並屠其家以叛，阻卜執阿裏底以獻，而沿邊諸部皆叛。十二月丙寅，奉遷南京諸帝石像於中京觀德殿，景宗及宣獻皇后於上京五鸞殿。壬申，振奉聖州饑民。庚辰，賜皇弟秦晉國王隆慶鐵券。癸未，劉晨言殿中高可垣、中京留守推官李可舉治獄明允，詔超遷之。甲申，詔諸道水災饑民質男女者，起來年正月，日計傭錢十文，價折傭盡，遣還其家。歸州言其居民本新羅所遷，未習文字，請設學以教之，詔允所請。貴德、龍化、儀坤、雙、遼、同、祖七州，至是有詔始征商。己丑，詔諸鎮建宣敕樓。

In the first year of Kaitai, on the jisi new moon of the first spring month Song sent Zhao Xiang and Fu Chenghan with congratulations. On guiwei day Jurchen chieftains of the thirty divisions of Changbai Mountain came with tribute and asked for ranks and titles; their request was granted. On jiashen day the court encamped at Prince's Courtyard. On bingxu day the court worshipped at Muye Mountain from afar. On dinghai day Jurchen Grand Guardian Punian and others came to court. On wuzi day the court hunted at Maiheru Forest. On gengyin day sacrifice was performed at Muye Mountain. On xinmao day Yisuguan Great King Yilixi came to court. On renzi day of the second month the court encamped at Ruilu Plain. On jiaxu day of the third month Wei Prefecture was made an observation commission independent of the Wuding Army. On yihai day the court went to Wei Marsh. On dingchou day an edict enfeoffed eight imperial daughters as commandery princesses. On yiyou day an edict ordered a date chosen for the mountain-worship and great willow-shooting rites and directed Northern Chancellery chancellor and imperial son-in-law Prince of Lanling Xiao Ning and Privy Commissioner and Minister of Works Xing Baozhi to supervise the relevant offices in preparing the ritual equipment. On dinghai day Prince of Chu Longyou was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Qi and left to guard the Eastern Capital. On gengzi day of the fourth summer month Goryeo sent Cai Zhongshun asking to resume vassal status as before; an edict ordered King Xun to come to court in person. On renchen day Western Xia sent envoys presenting fine horses. On jiyou day sacrifice was offered to the Wind Lord. On xinyou day former Mengfu House changwen Xiao Fonu was appointed Left yilibi. On the wuchen new moon of the fifth month the court returned to the Upper Capital. An edict put Pei Xuangan and Xing Xiang in charge of the Ministry of Rites examinations; nineteen jinshi including Shi Jian passed and were granted degrees. Imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong was appointed defense commissioner of Zheng Prefecture. On yihai day Xing Baozhi was appointed military commissioner of the Datong Army. In the sixth month the court encamped at the Upper Capital. On bingzi day of the seventh autumn month Yelü Suizhen was made military commissioner of the Liaoxing Army, Suizheng Northern Chancellery xuanhui commissioner, Zhang Zhaoying Southern Chancellery xuanhui commissioner, Yelü Shouyi Upper Capital vice garrison commander, and Kou Qing military commissioner of the Zhangde Army. Yelü Shishennu and Li Cao were appointed birthday congratulation envoys to Song, and Xiao Niegun and Qi Tai New Year's Day congratulation envoys to Song. Jinshi Kang Wenzhao, Zhang Suchen, and Lang Xuanda were punished for criticizing examination supervisors Pei Xuangan and Xing Xiang for favoritism; Secretariat regular-script compiler Li Wan submitted a memorial whose language amounted to resentment and slander; all were flogged and banished, and Wan was conscripted to the River Ironworks. On the bingshen new moon of the eighth month Iron Li Nasha and others sent more than one hundred Wurang households to Bin Prefecture and were granted silk fabrics. That day Nasha asked for a Buddha image and Confucian texts; an edict granted one Protect-the-Nation Benevolent-King Buddha Image and one set each of the Book of Changes, Classic of Poetry, Book of Documents, Spring and Autumn Annals, and Record of Rites. On jiwei day Goryeo King Xun sent Tian Gongzhi with a memorial claiming illness and inability to come to court; an edict ordered the six prefectures' territory seized again. That month Prince of Qi Longyou died, and court was suspended for five days. On xinhai day of the tenth winter month the court went to the Central Capital. On dingmao day of the intercalary month Longyou was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and given the posthumous title Renxiao. On the jiawu new moon of the eleventh month civil and military officials bestowed on the Emperor the honorific Hongwen Xuanwu Zundao Zhide Chongren Guangxiao Congrui Zhaosheng Shenzan Tianfu Emperor. A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Kaitai. Youdu Prefecture was renamed Xijin Prefecture, Jibei County was renamed Xijin County, Youdu County was renamed Wanping County, and grace was extended throughout the realm. On jihai day the Western Xia envoys and Eastern Head Serving Official Cao Wenbin, Lü Wengui, Dou Guiyou, Shou Rong, Wu Yuanzheng, and others were granted ranks in varying measure. On guimao day former Liaozhou clerk Zhang Tingmei, who had six generations living together, and Yikun Prefecture's Liu Xingyin, who had four generations living together, were each granted three years' tax exemption. On jiachen day Northwestern Road pacification commissioner Xiao Tuyu reported that Seven Tribes Grand Preceptor Alidi, because of resentment among his people, had killed native military commissioner Ba An and slaughtered his family in rebellion; the Zubu captured Alidi and presented him, while frontier tribes all rebelled. On bingyin day of the twelfth month stone statues of the emperors from Nanjing were ceremonially moved to Guande Hall at the Central Capital, and Emperor Jingzong and Empress Xuanxian to Wuluan Hall at the Upper Capital. On renshen day famine victims of Fengsheng Prefecture were relieved. On gengchen day the Emperor's younger brother King of Qin-Jin Longqing was granted an iron tally of privilege. On guiwei day Liu Chen reported that Palace attendant Gao Keyuan and Central Capital regent judicial assistant Li Keju handled cases fairly and clearly, and an edict ordered their exceptional promotion. On jiashen day an edict ordered that among flood victims in all circuits who had pawned sons and daughters, starting from the first month of the coming year they would pay ten cash per day in hired labor until the pawn price was worked off, then be sent home. Guizhou reported that its inhabitants had originally been relocated from Silla and had not learned writing; they requested schools be established to teach them, and the request was granted. Guide, Longhua, Yikun, Shuang, Liao, Tong, and Zu — seven prefectures — from this time received an edict beginning to levy commercial taxes. On jichou day an edict ordered all garrison towns to build proclamation towers.

二年春正月癸巳朔，以裴玄感為翰林承旨，邢祥給事中，石用中翰林學士，呂德推樞密直學士，張儉政事舍人，邢抱質加開府儀同三司、守司空兼侍中，王繼忠中京留守、檢校太師，戶部侍郎劉涇加工部尚書，駙馬蕭紹宗加檢校太師，耶律控溫加政事令，封幽王。丁未，如瑞鹿原。北院樞密使耶律化哥封豳王。以馬氏為麗儀，耿氏淑儀，尚寢白氏昭儀，尚服李氏順儀，尚功艾氏芳儀，尚書孫氏和儀。己未，錄囚。烏古、敵烈叛，右皮室詳穩延壽率兵討之。是月，達旦國兵圍鎮州，州軍堅守，尋引去。二月丙子，詔以麥務川為象雷縣，女河川為神水縣，羅家軍為閭山縣，山子川為富庶縣，習家砦為龍山縣，阿覽峪為勸農縣，松山川為松山縣，金甸子為金原縣。壬午，遣北院樞密副使高正按察諸道獄。三月壬辰朔，化哥以西北路略平，留兵戍鎮州，赴行在。夏四月甲子，拜日。詔從上京請，以韓斌所括贍國、撻魯河、奉、豪等州戶二萬五千四百有奇，置長霸、興仁、保和等十縣。丙子，如緬山。五月辛卯朔，復命化哥等西討。六月辛酉朔，遣中丞耶律資忠使高麗，取六州舊地。秋七月壬辰，烏古、敵烈皆復故疆。乙未，西南招討使、政事令斜軫奏党項諸部叛者皆遁黃河北模赧山，其不叛者曷黨、烏迷兩部因據其地，今復西遷，詰之則曰逐水草，不早圖之，後恐為患。又聞前後叛者多投西夏，西夏不納。詔遣使再問西遷之意，若歸故地，則可就加撫諭。使不報，上怒，欲伐之。遂詔李德昭：「今党項叛，我欲西伐，爾當東擊，毋失掎角之勢。」仍命諸軍各市肥馬。丁酉，以惕隱耶律滌洌為南府宰相，太尉五哥為惕隱。癸卯，釣魚曲溝。戊申，詔以敦睦宮子錢振貧民。己酉，化哥等破阻卜酋長烏八之眾。丁卯，封皇子宗訓大內惕隱。八月壬戌，遣引進使李延弘賜夏國王李德昭及義成公主車馬。己丑，耶律資忠使高麗還。冬十月己未朔，畋麃井之北。命耶律阿營等使宋賀生辰。辛酉，駐蹕長濼。丙寅。詳穩張馬留獻女直人知高麗事者。上問之，曰：「臣三年前為高麗所虜，為郎官，故知之。自開京東馬行七日，有大砦，廣如開京，旁州所貢珍異，皆積於此。勝、羅等州之南，亦有二大砦，所積如之。若大軍行由前路，取曷蘇館女直北，直渡鴨祿江，並大河而上，至郭州與大路會，高麗可取而有也。」上納之。十一月甲午，錄囚。癸丑，樞密使豳王化哥以西征有罪，削其官封，出為大同軍節度使。十二月甲子，以北院大王耶律世良為北院樞密使，封岐王。以宰臣劉晟監修國史，牛璘為彰國軍節度使，蕭孝穆為西北路招討使。放進士鮮于茂昭等六人及第。

In the second year, on the guisi new moon of the first spring month, Pei Xuangan was appointed Hanlin Academician-in-Attendance, Xing Xiang Supervising Secretary, Shi Yongzhong Hanlin Academician, Lü Detui Privy Council Academician, and Zhang Jian Political Affairs Attendant; Xing Baozhi was promoted to Acting Minister of Works with Extraordinary Honorific Equal to Three Councillors and Concurrent Palace Grand Secretary; Wang Jizhong was made Central Capital regent and Acting Grand Preceptor; Vice Minister of Revenue Liu Jing was promoted to Minister of Works; imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong was promoted to Acting Grand Preceptor; and Yelü Kongwen was promoted to Political Affairs Commissioner and enfeoffed as King of You. On dingwei day the court went to Ruilu Plain. Northern Court Privy Council Commissioner Yelü Huage was enfeoffed as King of Bin. The Ma clan was made Elegant Consort, the Geng clan Pure Consort, Palace Bed Attendant Bai Bright Consort, Palace Attire Attendant Li Gracious Consort, Palace Works Attendant Ai Fragrant Consort, and Palace Secretary Attendant Sun Harmonious Consort. On jiwei day the court reviewed prisoners. The Wugu and Dilie rebelled, and Right Pishi Xiaowen commander Yanshou led troops to suppress them. That month Dadan state troops besieged Zhen Prefecture; the prefectural army held firm and the besiegers soon withdrew. On bingzi day of the second month an edict established Maiwu River as Xiangle County, Nühe River as Shenshui County, Luojia Army as Lüshan County, Shanzi River as Fushu County, Xijia Stockade as Longshan County, Alan Valley as Quannong County, Songshan River as Songshan County, and Jindianzi as Jinyuan County. On renwu day Northern Court Privy Council Vice Commissioner Gao Zheng was sent to inspect prisons in all circuits. On the renchen new moon of the third month Huage, because the Northwestern Route was largely pacified, left troops to garrison Zhen Prefecture and went to the mobile court. On jiazi day of the fourth summer month the court worshipped the sun. An edict granted the Upper Capital's request to register more than 25,400 households from Shanyu, Talu River, Feng, Hao, and other prefectures surveyed by Han Bin, establishing ten counties including Changba, Xingren, and Baohe. On bingzi day the court went to Mianshan. On the xinmao new moon of the fifth month Huage and others were again ordered on a western campaign. On the xinyou new moon of the sixth month Censor Yelü Zizhong was sent as envoy to Goryeo to recover the six old prefectures. On renchen day of the seventh autumn month the Wugu and Dilie all recovered their former territories. On yiwei day Southwestern Road pacification commissioner and Political Affairs Commissioner Xiezhen reported that rebel Tangut tribes had all fled north of the Yellow River to Mo'nanshan; the non-rebel Hedang and Wumi tribes had occupied their lands and now had moved west again; when questioned they said they were following pasture and water, and if not dealt with early they might become a later menace. It was also heard that many rebels before and after had fled to Western Xia, which did not accept them. An edict ordered envoys sent again to ask their intent in moving west; if they returned to their former lands, they could then be reassured and pacified on the spot. The envoys brought no reply; the Emperor was angered and wished to attack them. Then an edict was sent to Li Dezhao: "Now the Tangut have rebelled; I wish to campaign west. You should strike east and not lose the pincer advantage. " Orders were also given for all armies to buy fat horses at market. On dingyou day tiyin Yelü Dilie was appointed Southern Court Grand Chancellor, and Grand Commandant Wuge was appointed tiyin. On guimao day the court fished at Qugou. On wushen day an edict ordered relief for the poor using interest from Dunmu Palace funds. On jiyou day Huage and others defeated the forces of Zubu chief Wuba. On dingmao day Prince Zongxun was enfeoffed as Inner Palace tiyin. On renxu day of the eighth month Introducing Commissioner Li Yanhong was sent to grant King of Western Xia Li Dezhao and Princess Yicheng carriages and horses. On jichou day Yelü Zizhong returned from his mission to Goryeo. On the jiwei new moon of the tenth winter month the court hunted north of Piaojing. Yelü Aying and others were ordered as envoys to Song to congratulate the emperor's birthday. On xinyou day the court halted at Changbo. On bingyin day. Xiaowen commander Zhang Maliu presented a Jurchen who knew Goryeo affairs. The Emperor questioned him; he said: "Three years ago I was captured by Goryeo and served as a court official, so I know. From Kaegyeong eastward seven days' ride by horse there is a great fortress as large as Kaegyeong; rare tribute from neighboring prefectures is all stored there. South of Seung, Na, and other prefectures there are also two great fortresses with similar stores. If the great army marched by the forward route, taking Hasugwan Jurchen northward, crossing the Yalu River straight and proceeding up the great river to Gwak Prefecture to join the main road, Goryeo could be taken and possessed. " The Emperor accepted it. On jiawu day of the eleventh month the court reviewed prisoners. On guichou day Privy Council Commissioner King of Bin Huage was stripped of rank and fief for faults in the western campaign and sent out as military commissioner of Datong Army. On jiazi day of the twelfth month Northern Court Great King Yelü Shiliang was made Northern Court Privy Council Commissioner and enfeoffed as King of Qi. Grand Chancellor Liu Sheng was put in charge of compiling the National History; Niu Lin was made military commissioner of Zhangguo Army; and Xiao Xiaomu was made Northwestern Road pacification commissioner. Jinshi Xianyu Maozhao and five others passed the examinations.

三年春正月己丑，錄囚。阻卜酋長烏八來朝，封為王。乙未，如渾河。丁酉，女直及鐵驪各遣使來貢。是夕，彗星見西方。丙午，畋潢河濱。壬子，帝及皇后獵瑞鹿原。二月戊午，詔增樞密使以下月俸。甲子，遣上京副留守耶律資忠復使高麗取六州舊地。三月庚子，遣耶律世良城招州。戊申，南京、奉聖、平、蔚、雲、應、朔等州置轉運使。夏四月戊午，詔南京管內毋淹刑獄，以妨農務。癸亥，烏古叛。乙亥，沙州回鶻曹順遣使來貢。丙子，以西北路招討都監蕭孝穆為北府宰相。五月乙酉朔，清暑緬山。六月乙亥，合拔裏、乙室二國舅為一帳，以乙室夷離畢蕭敵烈為詳穩以總之。甲申，封皇侄胡都古為廣平郡王。是夏，詔國舅詳穩蕭敵烈、東京留守耶律團石等討高麗，造浮梁於鴨淥江，城保、宣義、定遠等州。秋七月乙酉朔，如平地松林。壬辰，詔政事省、樞密院，酒間授官釋罪，毋即奉行，明日覆奏。八月甲寅朔，幸沙嶺。九月丁酉，八部敵烈殺其詳穩稍瓦，皆叛，詔南府宰相耶律吾剌葛招撫之。辛亥，釋敵烈數人，令招諭其眾。壬子，耶律世良遣使獻敵烈俘。冬十月甲寅朔，幸中京。丙子，以旗鼓拽剌詳穩題裏姑為奚六部大王。放進士張用行等三十一人及第出身。

In the third year, on jichou day of the first spring month, the court reviewed prisoners. Zubu chief Wuba came to court and was enfeoffed as king. On yiwei day the court went to the Hun River. On dingyou day the Jurchen and Iron Li each sent envoys with tribute. That evening a comet appeared in the west. On bingwu day the court hunted on the Huang River banks. On renzi day the Emperor and Empress hunted at Ruilu Plain. On wuwu day of the second month an edict increased the monthly salaries of officials from Privy Council Commissioner downward. On jiazi day Upper Capital deputy regent Yelü Zizhong was again sent as envoy to Goryeo to recover the six old prefectures. On gengzi day of the third month Yelü Shiliang was sent to fortify Zhao Prefecture. On wushen day transport commissioners were established in Nanjing, Fengsheng, Ping, Yu, Yun, Ying, Shuo, and other prefectures. On wuwu day of the fourth summer month an edict ordered that within Nanjing's jurisdiction criminal cases should not be delayed so as not to hinder agricultural work. On guihai day the Wugu rebelled. On yihai day Shazhou Uyghur Cao Shun sent envoys with tribute. On bingzi day Northwestern Road pacification surveillance commissioner Xiao Xiaomu was appointed Northern Court Grand Chancellor. On the yiyou new moon of the fifth month the court went to Mianshan for the summer retreat. On yihai day of the sixth month the two imperial maternal clans Bali and Yishi were merged into one tent, with Yishi Irbi Xiao Dilie appointed Xiaowen commander to oversee them. On jiashen day the Emperor's nephew Hudugu was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangping Commandery. That summer an edict ordered imperial maternal clan Xiaowen commander Xiao Dilie, Eastern Capital regent Yelü Tuanshi, and others to campaign against Goryeo, building a pontoon bridge on the Yalu River and fortifying Bao, Xuanyi, Dingyuan, and other prefectures. On the yiyou new moon of the seventh autumn month the court went to Pingdi Pine Forest. On renchen day an edict ordered the Political Affairs Department and Privy Council that appointments and releases granted during drinking should not be immediately executed but reported back the next day for confirmation. On the jiayin new moon of the eighth month the court visited Shaling. On dingyou day of the ninth month the eight tribes of Dilie killed their Xiaowen commander Shaowa and all rebelled; an edict ordered Southern Court Grand Chancellor Yelü Wulage to win them over. On xinhai day several Dilie captives were released and ordered to persuade their people. On renzi day Yelü Shiliang sent envoys presenting Dilie captives. On the jiayin new moon of the tenth winter month the court visited the Central Capital. On bingzi day Standard-and-Drum Zhualacha Xiaowen commander Tiligu was made Great King of the Xi Six Divisions. Jinshi Zhang Yongxing and thirty others passed the examinations.

四年春正月乙酉，如瑞鹿原。丙戌，詔耶律世良再伐迪烈得。戊子，命詳穩拔姑瀦水瑞鹿原，以備春蒐。丁酉，獵馬蘭澱。壬寅，東征。東京留守善寧、平章涅裏袞奏，已總大軍及女直諸部兵分道進討，遂遣使賫密詔軍前。二月壬子朔，如薩堤濼。于闐國來貢。夏四月癸丑，以林牙建福為北院大王。甲寅，蕭敵烈等伐高麗還。丙辰，曷蘇館部請括女直王殊只你戶舊無籍者，會其丁入賦役，從之。樞密使貫寧奏大破八部迪烈得，詔侍御撒剌獎諭，代行執手之禮。丙寅，耶律世良等上破阻卜俘獲數。戊辰，駐蹕沿柳湖。己巳，女直遣使來貢。壬申，耶律世良討烏古，破之。甲戌，遣使賞有功將校。世良討迪烈得至清泥堝。時於厥既平，朝廷議內徙其眾，於厥安土重遷，遂叛。世良懲創，既破迪烈得，輒殲其丁壯。勒兵渡曷剌河，進擊餘黨，斥候不謹，其將勃括聚兵稠林中，擊遼軍不備。遼軍小卻，結陣河曲。勃括是夜來襲。翌日，遼後軍至，勃括誘於厥之眾皆遁，世良追之，軍至險厄。勃括方阻險少休，遼軍偵知其所，世良不亟掩之，勃括輕騎遁去。獲其輜重及所誘於厥之眾，並遷迪烈得所獲轄麥裏部民，城臚朐河上以居之。是月，蕭楊哥尚南平郡主。五月辛巳，命北府宰相劉晟為都統，樞密使耶律世良為副，殿前都點檢蕭屈烈為都監以伐高麗。晟先攜家置邊郡，致緩師期，追還之。以世良、屈烈總兵進討。以耶律德政為遼興軍節度使，蕭年骨烈天成軍節度使。李仲舉卒，詔賻恤其家。六月庚戌，上拜日如禮。以麻都骨世勛，易衣馬為好。以上京留守耶律八哥為北院樞密副使。秋七月，上又拜日，遂幸秋山。自八月射鹿至於九月，復自癸丑至於辛酉，連獵於有柏、碎石、太保、響應、松山諸山。丁卯，與夷離畢、兵部尚書蕭榮寧定為交契，以重君臣之好。丙子，以旗鼓拽剌詳穩題裏姑為六部奚王。冬十月，駐蹕撻剌割濼。十一月庚申，詔汰東京僧，及命上京、中京洎諸宮選精兵五萬五千人以備東征。十二月，南巡海僥。還，幸顯州。

In the fourth year, on yiyou day of the first spring month, the court went to Ruilu Plain. On bingxu day an edict ordered Yelü Shiliang to campaign again against the Dilie. On wuzi day Xiaowen commander Bagu was ordered to dam water at Ruilu Plain in preparation for the spring hunt. On dingyou day the court hunted at Malan Marsh. On renyin day the eastern campaign began. Eastern Capital regent Shanning and Grand Secretary Nielihun reported that they had assembled the great army and Jurchen tribal troops for a divided advance; envoys were then sent carrying a secret edict to the army front. On the renzi new moon of the second month the court went to Sadi Marsh. Khotan sent tribute. On guichou day of the fourth summer month Linqiya Jianfu was made Northern Court Great King. On jiayin day Xiao Dilie and others returned from the campaign against Goryeo. On bingchen day the Hasugwan tribe requested registration of Jurchen Wang Shuzhini households previously unlisted, enrolling their adult males for taxation and corvée, and the request was granted. Privy Council Commissioner Guanning reported a great defeat of the eight tribes of Dilie; an edict ordered attendant Sala to convey commendation, performing the hand-clasp ceremony in his place. On bingyin day Yelü Shiliang and others reported the count of captives taken in defeating the Zubu. On wuchen day the court encamped at Lake Yanliu. On jisi day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute. On renshen day Yelü Shiliang attacked the Wugu and defeated them. On jiaxu day envoys were sent to reward the officers and soldiers who had distinguished themselves. Shiliang pursued the Dilie De as far as Qingni Gorge. The Yujue had just been pacified when the court proposed resettling them inland, but they clung to their homeland and rebelled. As punishment Shiliang, once he had broken the Dilie De, slaughtered their adult males. He led his troops across the Hela River to pursue the remnants, but careless scouting let the rebel general Bokuo mass men in thick woods and fall on the Liao army unawares. The Liao army fell back a short distance and formed ranks on the river bend. That night Bokuo launched a night attack. The next day Liao reinforcements arrived; Bokuo had incited the Yujue to scatter, and Shiliang pursued them into dangerous country. Bokuo had halted in a defile to rest; scouts found him, but Shiliang failed to strike quickly and Bokuo fled on fast horses. They took his baggage train and the Yujue he had won over, resettled the Xiabaili people captured from the Dilie De, and built a town on the Luch River for them. That month Xiao Yangge married the Princess of Nanping. On xinsi day of the fifth month Liu Sheng was appointed commander-in-chief, Yelü Shiliang deputy commander, and Xiao Qulie supervisory commander for a campaign against Goryeo. Sheng had moved his household to a frontier prefecture, delaying the campaign, and was recalled. Shiliang and Qulie were given overall command and marched to attack. Yelü Dezheng was appointed military commissioner of the Liaoxing Army and Xiao Nianguli military commissioner of the Tiancheng Army. Li Zhongju died, and an edict ordered funeral gifts and relief for his family. On gengxu day of the sixth month the Emperor performed the sun-worship rite. Robes and horses were exchanged with Madugu of Shixiong as a bond of friendship. Upper Capital regent Yelü Bage was appointed deputy commissioner of the Northern Court Military Affairs Commission. In the seventh autumn month the Emperor again performed the sun-worship rite, then went to Autumn Mountain. From the eighth month through the ninth the court hunted deer, and from guichou to xinyou hunted continuously on Mount Youbai, Suishi, Taibao, Xiangying, Song Mountain, and others. On dingmao day the Emperor entered a pact of friendship with yilibi and Minister of War Xiao Rongning to deepen the bond between ruler and minister. On bingzi day Tiligu, qigu drala xianwen, was appointed king of the Six Xi Divisions. In the tenth winter month the court encamped at Talage Marsh. On gengshen day of the eleventh month an edict culled Buddhist monks in the Eastern Capital and ordered the Upper Capital, Central Capital, and the palace households to furnish fifty-five thousand elite troops for the eastern campaign. In the twelfth month the court made a southern tour to Haiqiao. On the return the court visited Xian Prefecture.

五年春正月丁未，北幸。庚戌，耶律世良、蕭屈烈與高麗戰於郭州西，破之，斬首數萬級，盡獲其輜重。乙卯，師次南海軍，耶律世良薨於軍。癸酉，駐蹕雪林。二月己卯，阻卜長來朝。辛巳，如薩堤濼。庚寅，以前東京統軍使耶律韓留為右夷離畢。戊戌，皇子宗真生。三月乙卯，鼻骨德長撒保特、賽剌等來貢。辛酉，諸道獄空，詔進階賜物。丙寅，以前北院大王耶律敬溫為阿紥割只。辛未，党項魁可來降。夏四月乙亥，振招州民。戊寅，以左夷離畢蕭合卓為北院樞密使，曷魯寧為副使。庚辰，清暑孤樹澱。五月甲子，尚書蕭姬隱坐出使後期，削其官。丁卯，以耿元吉為戶部使。六月，以政事舍人吳克昌按察霸州刑獄。丁丑，回鶻獻孔雀。秋七月甲辰，獵於赤山。八月丙子，幸懷州，有事於諸陵。戊寅，還上京。九月癸卯，皇弟南京留守秦晉國王隆慶來朝，上親出迎勞，至實德山，因同獵於松山。乙丑，駐蹕杏堝。冬十月甲午，封秦晉國王隆慶長子查割中山郡王，次子遂哥樂安郡王。十一月辛丑朔，以參知政事馬保忠同知樞密院事、監修國史。丁巳，以北面林牙蕭隈窪為國舅詳隱。十二月乙酉，秦晉國王隆慶還，至北安薨，訃聞，上為哀慟，輟朝七日。丁酉，宋遣張遜、王承德來賀千齡節。是歲，放進士孫傑等四十八人及第。

In the fifth year, on dingwei day of the first spring month, the court made a northern tour. On gengxu day Yelü Shiliang and Xiao Qulie fought Goryeo west of Guo Prefecture, broke them, took tens of thousands of heads, and seized all their baggage. On yimao day the army reached Nanhai Army and Yelü Shiliang died in camp. On guiyou day the court encamped at Xuelin. On jimao day of the second month a Zubu chieftain came to court. On xinsi day the court went to Sadai Marsh. On gengyin day former Eastern Capital army commander Yelü Hanliu was appointed right yilibi. On wuxu day Prince Zongzhen was born. On yimao day of the third month Bigude chieftains Sabote, Saila, and others came with tribute. On xinyou day the prisons in every circuit stood empty, and an edict ordered promotions and gifts. On bingyin day former Northern Court great king Yelü Jingwen was appointed azha gezhi. On xinwei day Tangut chief Kuikke submitted. On yihai day of the fourth summer month relief was given to the people of Zhao Prefecture. On wuyin day left yilibi Xiao Hezhuo was appointed Northern Court commissioner of military affairs, with Heluning as deputy. On gengchen day the court took the summer retreat at Gushu Marsh. On jiazi day of the fifth month Minister Xiao Jiyin was dismissed for returning late from an envoy mission. On dingmao day Geng Yuanji was appointed commissioner of the household bureau. In the sixth month administrative secretary Wu Kechang was sent to review criminal cases in Ba Prefecture. On dingchou day the Uyghur presented a peacock. On jiachen day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Red Mountain. On bingzi day of the eighth month the court visited Huai Prefecture and offered rites at the imperial tombs. On wuyin day the court returned to the Upper Capital. On guimao day of the ninth month the Emperor's younger brother, Nanjing regent and Qin-Jin State King Longqing, came to court; the Emperor went out in person to welcome him, and at Mount Shide they hunted together on Song Mountain. On yichou day the court encamped at Xing Pass. On jiawu day of the tenth winter month Longqing's eldest son Zhage was made Prince of Zhongshan and his second son Suige Prince of Le'an. On the xinchou new moon of the eleventh month associate state counselor Ma Baozhong was made concurrent commissioner of military affairs and director of the state history. On dingsi day Northern Court linya Xiao Weiwo was appointed imperial maternal uncle xianyin. On yiyou day of the twelfth month Qin-Jin State King Longqing died at Bei'an on his way back; when word reached the court the Emperor was stricken with grief and suspended audience for seven days. On dingyou day Song sent Zhang Xun and Wang Chengde to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival. That year Sun Jie and forty-seven others passed the examinations.

六年春正月癸卯，如錐子河。二月甲戌，以公主賽哥殺無罪婢，駙馬蕭圖玉不能齊家，降公主為縣主，削圖玉同平章事。丁丑，詔國舅帳詳穩蕭隗窪將本部兵東征高麗，其國舅司事以都監攝之。庚辰，以南面林牙涅合為南院大王。三月乙巳，如顯州，葬秦晉國王隆慶。有事於顯、乾二陵。追冊隆慶為太弟。夏四月辛卯，封隆慶少子謝家奴為長沙郡王，以樞密使漆水郡王耶律制心權知諸行宮都部署事。壬辰，禁命婦再醮。丙申，如涼陘。五月戊戌朔，命樞密使蕭合卓為都統，漢人行宮都部署王繼忠為副，殿前都點檢蕭屈烈為都監，以伐高麗。翌日，賜合卓劍，俾得專殺。丙午，錄囚。己酉，設四帳都詳穩。甲寅，以南京統軍使蕭惠為右夷離畢。乙卯，祠木葉山、潢河。乙丑，駐蹕九層臺。六月戊辰朔，德妃蕭氏賜死，葬兔兒山西。後數日，大風起冢上，晝暝，大雷電而雨不止者逾月。是月，南京諸縣蝗。秋七月辛亥，如秋山。遣禮部尚書劉京、翰林學士吳叔達、知制誥仇正己、起居舍人程翥、吏部員外郎南承顏、禮部員外郎王景運分路按察刑獄。辛酉，以西南路招討請，置寧仁縣於勝州。九月庚子，還上京，以皇子屬思生，大赦。丁未，以駙馬蕭璉、節度使化哥、知制誥仇正己、楊佶充賀宋生辰正旦使副。乙卯，蕭合卓等攻高麗興化軍不克，還師。冬十月丁卯，南京路饑，免雲、應、朔、弘等州粟振之。辛未，獵鏵子河。庚寅，駐蹕達離山。十一月乙卯，建州節度使石匡弼卒。十二月丁卯，上輕騎還上京。戊子，宋遣李行簡、張信來賀千齡節。翌日，宋馮元、張綸來賀正旦。

In the sixth year, on guimao day of the first spring month, the court went to the Zhuizi River. On jiaxu day of the second month Princess Saige was demoted to county mistress and Xiao Tuyu was stripped of his co-equal chief councillor title because she had killed an innocent maidservant and he could not keep his household in order. On dingchou day an edict ordered imperial maternal uncle xianwen Xiao Aiwo to lead his command east against Goryeo, with the supervisory commander acting in his office during the campaign. On gengchen day Southern Court linya Niehe was appointed Southern Court great king. On yisi day of the third month the court went to Xian Prefecture and buried Qin-Jin State King Longqing. Sacrifice was offered at the Xian and Qian mausoleums. Longqing was posthumously enregistered as Imperial Elder Brother. On xinmao day of the fourth summer month Longqing's youngest son Xiejianu was made Prince of Changsha, and Commissioner of Military Affairs Prince of Qishui Yelü Zhixin was appointed acting director of all traveling palace deployments. On renchen day an edict forbade widows from remarrying. On bingshen day the court went to Liang Pass. On the wuxu new moon of the fifth month Xiao Hezhuo was appointed commander-in-chief, Wang Jizhong deputy commander, and Xiao Qulie supervisory commander for a campaign against Goryeo. The next day Hezhuo was given a sword conferring authority to execute at his discretion. On bingwu day prisoners were reviewed. On jiyou day chief xianwen posts were established for the four accounts. On jiayin day Nanjing army commander Xiao Hui was appointed right yilibi. On yimao day sacrifice was offered at Muye Mountain and on the Huang River. On yichou day the court encamped at the Nine-Tier Terrace. On the wuchen new moon of the sixth month Noble Consort Xiao was ordered to take her own life and was buried west of Rabbit Mountain. Several days later a great wind rose over the tomb, daylight turned dark, and thunder, lightning, and unceasing rain lasted more than a month. That month locusts afflicted the counties of Nanjing. On xinhai day of the seventh autumn month the court went to Autumn Mountain. Liu Jing, Wu Shuda, Qiu Zhengji, Cheng Zhu, Nan Chengyan, and Wang Jingyun were sent along separate routes to review criminal cases. On xinyou day, at the Southwestern Pacification Commissioner's request, Ningren County was established in Sheng Prefecture. On gengzi day of the ninth month the court returned to the Upper Capital and proclaimed a general amnesty on the birth of Prince Shusi. On dingwei day Xiao Lian, Huage, Qiu Zhengji, and Yang Ji were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on the Emperor's birthday and New Year's Day. On yimao day Xiao Hezhuo and others failed to take Goryeo's Xinghua Army and withdrew. On dingmao day of the tenth winter month famine struck the Nanjing circuit, and grain levies were remitted and relief distributed in Yun, Ying, Shuo, Hong, and other prefectures. On xinwei day the court hunted on the Huazi River. On gengyin day the court encamped at Mount Dali. On yimao day of the eleventh month Jian Prefecture military commissioner Shi Kuangbi died. On dingmao day of the twelfth month the Emperor rode back to the Upper Capital with a light escort. On wuzi day Song sent Li Xingjian and Zhang Xin to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival. The next day Song sent Feng Yuan and Zhang Lun to congratulate New Year's Day.
016: 七年春正月甲辰，如達離山。二月乙丑朔，拜日，如渾河。三月辛丑，命東北越裏篤、剖阿裏、奧裏米、蒲奴裏、鐵驪等五部歲貢貂皮六萬五千，馬三百。丙午，烏古部節度使蕭普達討叛命敵烈，滅之。夏四月，拜日。丙寅，振川、饒二州饑。辛未，振中京貧乏。癸酉，禁匿名書。壬辰，以三司使呂德懋為樞密副使。閏月壬子，以蕭進忠為彰武軍節度使兼五州制置。戊午，吐蕃王並裏尊奏，凡朝貢，乞假道夏國，從之。五月丙寅，皇子宗真封梁王，宗元永清軍節度使，宗簡右衛大將軍，宗願左驍衛大將軍，宗偉右衛大將軍，皇侄宗範昭義軍節度使，宗熙鎮國軍節度使，宗亮絳州節度使，宗弼濮州觀察使，宗奕曹州防禦使，宗顯、宗肅皆防禦使。以張儉守司徒兼政事令。六月丙申，品打魯瑰部節度使勃魯裏至鼻灑河，遇微雨，忽天地晦冥，大風飄四十三人飛旋空中，良久乃墮數里外。勃魯裏幸獲免。一酒壺在地反不移。八月丙午，行大射柳之禮。庚申，以耶律留寧、吳守達使宋賀生辰，蕭高九、馬貽謀使宋賀正旦。加平章蕭弘義開府儀同三司、尚父兼政事令。秋七月甲子，詔翰林待詔陳升寫《南征得勝圖》於上京五鸞殿。丁卯，蒲奴裏部來貢。九月庚申朔，蒲昵國使奏本國與烏裏國封壤相接，數侵掠不寧，賜詔諭之，戊辰，詔內外官，因事受賕，事覺而稱子孫仆從者，禁之。庚午，錄囚。括馬給東征軍。是月，駐蹕土河川。冬十月，名中京新建二殿曰延慶，曰永安。壬寅，以順義軍節度使石用中為漢人行宮都部署。丙辰，詔以東平郡王蕭排押為都統，殿前都點檢蕭虛列為副統，東京留守耶律八哥為都監，伐高麗。仍諭高麗守吏，能率眾自歸者厚賞，堅壁相拒者追悔無及。十一月壬戌，以呂德懋知吏部尚書，楊又玄知詳覆院，劉晟為霸州節度使，北府宰相劉慎行為彰武軍節度使。庚辰，禁服用明金、縷金、貼金。戊子，幸中京。十二月丁酉，宋遣呂夷簡、曹璋來賀千齡節。是月，蕭排押等與高麗戰於茶、陀二河，遼軍失利，天雲、右皮室二軍沒溺者眾，遙輦帳詳穩阿果達、客省使酌古、渤海詳穩高清明、天雲軍詳穩海裏等皆死之。放進士張克恭等三十七人及第。

In the seventh year of Tonghe, on jiachen day of the first spring month the court went to Dali Mountain. On the yichou new moon of the second month the court worshipped the sun and went to Hun River. On xinchou day of the third month the five northeastern tribes Yuelidu, Pouali, Aolimi, Punuli, and Tieli were ordered to submit yearly tribute of sixty-five thousand sable pelts and three hundred horses. On bingwu day Wugu tribal military commissioner Xiao Puda attacked the rebel Dilie and destroyed him. In the fourth summer month the court worshipped the sun. On bingyin day famine relief was distributed in Chuan and Rao Prefectures. On xinwei day poverty relief was distributed in the Central Capital. On guiyou day anonymous letters were forbidden. On renchen day Three Departments commissioner Lü Demao was appointed Privy Vice Commissioner. On renzi day of the intercalary month Xiao Jinzhong was appointed Zhangwu Army military commissioner and concurrently commissioner for five prefectures. On wuwu day Tibetan king Binglizun memorialized that for all tributary missions he asked to pass through Xia territory; permission was granted. On bingyin day of the fifth month Prince Zongzhen was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang; Zongyuan was made Yongqing Army military commissioner; Zongjian Right Guard senior general; Zongyuan Left Xiao Guard senior general; Zongwei Right Guard senior general; imperial nephew Zongfan Zhaoyi Army military commissioner; Zongxi Zhenguo Army military commissioner; Zongliang Jiang Prefecture military commissioner; Zongbi Pu Prefecture observation commissioner; Zongyi Cao Prefecture defense commissioner; and Zongxian and Zongsu both defense commissioners. Zhang Jian was appointed acting Minister over the Masses and concurrent Political Affairs Commissioner. On bingshen day of the sixth month Pindaluogui tribal military commissioner Boluri reached Bisa River in light rain when heaven and earth suddenly darkened; a strong wind swept forty-three men spinning through the air, and after a long time they fell several li away. Boluri fortunately escaped unharmed. One wine jug on the ground did not move at all. On bingwu day of the eighth month the court performed the great willow-shooting rite. On gengshen day Yelü Liuning and Wu Shouda were appointed envoys to Song to congratulate the Emperor's birthday, and Xiao Gaojiu and Ma Yimou envoys to Song to congratulate New Year's Day. Associate Grand Chancellor Xiao Hongyi was promoted to Extraordinary Honorific Equal to Three Councillors, Esteemed Father, and concurrent Political Affairs Commissioner. On jiazi day of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered Hanlin awaiting-draft Chen Sheng to paint the Victory Chart of the Southern Campaign at the Five Phoenix Hall in the Upper Capital. On dingmao day the Punuli tribe came with tribute. On the gengshen new moon of the ninth month the Punii envoy reported that his country and Wuli shared a border and had repeatedly raided each other; an edict was issued to instruct them. On wuchen day an edict forbade inner and outer officials who accept bribes and, when discovered, blame children or servants. On gengwu day prisoners were reviewed. Horses were requisitioned for the eastern expedition army. That month the court encamped at Tuhe River valley. In the tenth winter month two newly built halls in the Central Capital were named Yanqing and Yongan. On renyin day Shunyi Army military commissioner Shi Yongzhong was appointed Han Chinese palace metropolitan garrison commander. On bingchen day an edict made Eastern Capital Prince Xiao Paiya supreme commander, Palace Front inspector general Xiao Xulie vice commander, and Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage inspector general for a campaign against Goryeo. Goryeo garrison officials were also told that those who led their people to surrender would be richly rewarded, while those who held fast would regret it too late. On renxu day of the eleventh month Lü Demao was assigned to manage the Ministry of Personnel, Yang Youxuan the Detailed Review Bureau, Liu Sheng was made Ba Prefecture military commissioner, and Northern Chancellery chancellor Liu Shenxing Zhangwu Army military commissioner. On gengchen day the wearing of bright gold, filigree gold, and gold leaf was forbidden. On wuzi day the court visited the Central Capital. On dingyou day of the twelfth month Song sent Lü Yijian and Cao Zhang to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival. That month Xiao Paiya and others fought Goryeo at the Cha and Tuo rivers; the Liao army was defeated and many from the Tianyun and Right Pishi armies drowned; Yaolian tent xiangwen Aguoda, Reception Bureau commissioner Zhuogu, Bohai xiangwen Gao Qingming, Tianyun Army xiangwen Haili, and others all died. At the palace examination jinshi Zhang Kegong and thirty-seven others passed and were granted degrees.

八年春正月，宋遣陳堯佐、張群來賀。壬戌，鐵驪來貢。建景宗廟於中京。封沙州節度使曹順為敦煌郡王。二月丁未，以前南院樞密使韓制心為中京留守，漢人行宮都部署王繼忠南院樞密使。丙辰，祭風伯。三月己未，以契丹弘義宮使赫石為興聖宮都部署，前遙恩拈部節度使控骨裏積慶宮都部署，左祗候郎君耶律罕四捷軍都監。乙亥，東平王蕭韓寧、東京留守耶律八哥、國舅平章事蕭排押、林牙要只等討高麗還，坐失律，數其罪而釋之。己卯，詔加征高麗有功渤海將校官。壬午，閱飛龍院馬。癸未，回跋部太師踏剌葛來貢。丙戌，置東京渤海承奉官都知押班。夏四月戊子朔，如緬山。五月壬申，以駙馬蕭克忠為長寧軍節度使。乙亥，遷寧州渤海戶於遼、土二河之間。己卯，曷蘇館惕隱阿不葛、宰相賽剌來貢。六月戊子，錄征高麗戰歿將校子弟。己丑，以左夷離畢蕭解裏為西南面招討使，御史大夫蕭要只為夷離畢。乙亥，惕隱耶律合葛為南府宰相，南面林牙耶律韓留為惕隱。癸卯，弛大擺山猿嶺采木之禁。乙巳，以南皮室軍校等討高麗有功，賜金帛有差。秋七月己未，征高麗戰歿諸將，詔益封其妻。庚申，以東北路詳穩耶律獨叠為北院大王。辛酉，肴裏、涅哥二奚軍征高麗有功，皆賜金帛。癸亥，詔阻卜依舊歲貢馬千七百，駝四百四十，貂鼠皮萬、青鼠皮二萬五千。戊辰，觀稼。己巳，回跋部太保麻門來貢。庚午，觀市，曲赦市中系囚。命解寧、馬翼充賀宋生辰使副。八月庚寅，遣郎君曷不呂等率諸部兵會大軍討高麗。九月己巳，以石用中參知政事。宋遣崔遵度、王應昌來賀千齡節。壬申，錄囚。甲戌，復錄囚。庚辰，曷蘇館惕隱阿不割來貢。壬午，駐蹕土河川。冬十月乙酉，詔諸道，事無巨細，已斷者，每三月一次條奏。戊子，遣耶律繼崇、鄭玄瑕賀宋正旦。癸巳，詔橫帳三房不得與卑小帳族為婚；凡嫁娶，必奏而後行。癸卯，以前北院大王建福為阿紥割只。甲辰，改東路耗裏太保城為咸州，建節以領之。十一月甲寅，置雲州宣德縣。十二月辛卯，駐蹕中京。乙巳，以廣平郡王宗業為中京留守、大定尹，韓制心為惕隱。辛亥，高麗王詢遣使乞貢方物，詔納之。

In the eighth year of Tonghe, in the first spring month Song sent Chen Yaozuo and Zhang Qun with congratulations. On renxu day Tieli came with tribute. Emperor Jingzong's temple was built at the Central Capital. Shazhou military commissioner Cao Shun was enfeoffed as Prince of Dunhuang commandery. On dingwei day of the second month former Southern Privy Commissioner Han Zhixin was made Central Capital regent and Han Chinese palace metropolitan garrison commander Wang Jizhong Southern Privy Commissioner. On bingchen day sacrifice was offered to the Wind Lord. On jiwei day of the third month Khitan Hongyi Palace commissioner Heshi was made Xingsheng Palace metropolitan garrison commander, former Yao'en nian tribal military commissioner Kongguli Jiqing Palace metropolitan garrison commander, and Left attendant langjun Yelü Han Fourth Victory Army inspector general. On yihai day Eastern Capital Prince Xiao Hanning, Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage, imperial uncle-in-law Associate Grand Chancellor Xiao Paiya, linya Yaozhi, and others returned from the Goryeo campaign; charged with violating military discipline, their crimes were enumerated and they were released. On jimao day an edict added ranks for Bohai officers who had merit in the Goryeo campaign. On renwu day the Flying Dragon Court horses were inspected. On guiwei day Huiba tribal Grand Guardian Talage came with tribute. On bingxu day the Eastern Capital Bohai attendance officer metropolitan director and ranking supervisor was established. On the wuzi new moon of the fourth summer month the court went to Mian Mountain. On renshen day of the fifth month imperial son-in-law Xiao Kezhong was appointed Changning Army military commissioner. On yihai day Ning Prefecture Bohai households were relocated between the Liao and Tu rivers. On jimao day Hesuguan tiyin Abuge and chancellor Saila came with tribute. On wuzi day of the sixth month children of officers who died in the Goryeo campaign were enrolled. On jichou day Left yilibi Xiao Jieli was appointed Southwestern Pacification commissioner and Censor-in-Chief Xiao Yaozhi yilibi. On yihai day tiyin Yelü Hege was made Southern Chancellery chancellor and Southern linya Yelü Hanliu tiyin. On guimao day the prohibition on timber harvesting at Dabai Mountain and Yuanling was relaxed. On yisi day Southern Pishi Army officers and others were granted gold and silk in varying amounts for merit in the Goryeo campaign. On jiwei day of the seventh autumn month an edict increased enfeoffments for the wives of generals who died in the Goryeo campaign. On gengshen day Northeastern Route xiangwen Yelü Dujie was made Northern Chancellery Great King. On xinyou day the Yaoli and Niege Xi armies were granted gold and silk for merit in the Goryeo campaign. On guihai day an edict ordered Zubu to continue yearly tribute of one thousand seven hundred horses, four hundred forty camels, ten thousand sable-mouse pelts, and twenty-five thousand blue-mouse pelts. On wuchen day the court inspected the crops. On jisi day Huiba tribal Grand Guardian Mamne came with tribute. On gengwu day the court inspected the market and granted partial amnesty to prisoners held there. Jiening and Ma Yi were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on the Emperor's birthday. On gengyin day of the eighth month langjun Hebulu and others were dispatched to lead various tribal troops to join the main army against Goryeo. On jisi day of the ninth month Shi Yongzhong was appointed Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner. Song sent Cui Zundu and Wang Yingchang to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival. On renshen day prisoners were reviewed. On jiaxu day prisoners were reviewed again. On gengchen day Hesuguan tiyin Abugo came with tribute. On renwu day the court encamped at Tuhe River valley. On yiyou day of the tenth winter month an edict ordered all circuits to report decided matters great and small in itemized lists once every three months. On wuzi day Yelü Jichong and Zheng Xuanxia were dispatched to congratulate Song on New Year's Day. On guisi day an edict forbade the three horizontal-tent houses to marry with low small-tent clans; all marriages had to be memorialized before proceeding. On guimao day former Northern Chancellery Great King Jianfu was made azagazhi. On jiachen day Eastern Route Haoli Grand Guardian city was renamed Xian Prefecture and a military commission was established to govern it. On jiayin day of the eleventh month Xuande County was established in Yun Prefecture. On xinmao day of the twelfth month the court encamped at the Central Capital. On yisi day Prince of Guangping Zongye was made Central Capital regent and Dading intendant, and Han Zhixin tiyin. On xinhai day Goryeo King Xun sent envoys asking to resume tribute; an edict accepted their submission.

九年春正月，宋遣劉平、張元普來賀。二月，如鴛鴦濼。五月庚午，耶律資忠使高麗還，王詢表請稱藩納貢，歸所留王人只剌裏。只剌裏在高麗六年，忠節不屈，以為林牙。辛未，遣使釋王詢罪，並允其請。癸酉，以耶律宗教檢校太傅，宗誨啟聖軍節度使，劉晟太子太傅，仍賜保節功臣。秋七月庚戌朔，日有食之，詔以近臣代拜救日。甲寅，遣使賜沙州回鶻敦煌郡王曹順衣物。以查剌、耿元吉、韓九、宋璋為來年賀宋生辰正旦使副。九月戊午，以駙馬蕭紹宗平章事。丁卯，文武百僚奉表上尊號，不許；表三上，乃從之。乙亥，沙州回鶻敦煌郡王曹順遣使來貢。括諸道漢民馬賜東征軍。以夷離畢延寧為兵馬副都部署，總兵東征。是月，駐蹕金瓶濼。宋遣宋綬、駱繼倫賀千齡節。冬十月戊寅朔，以涅裏為奚王都監，突叠裏為北王府舍利軍詳穩。郎君老使沙州還，詔釋宿累。國家舊使遠國，多用犯徒罪而有才略者，使還，即除其罪。戊子，西南招討奏党項部有宋犀族輸貢不時，常有他意，宜以時遣使督之。詔曰：「邊鄙小族，歲有常貢。邊臣驕縱，征斂無度，彼懷懼不能自達耳。第遣清慎官將，示以恩信，無或侵漁，自然效順。」復奏諦居、叠烈德部言節度使韓留有惠政，今當代，請留。上命進其治狀。辛丑，如中京。壬寅，大食國遣使進象及方物，為子冊割請婚。十一月丁巳，以漆水郡王韓制心為南京留守、析津尹、兵馬都總管。己未，以夷離畢蕭孝順為南面諸行宮都部署，加左僕射。十二月丁亥，禁僧燃身煉指。戊子，詔中京建太祖廟，制度、祭器皆從古制。乙巳，詔來年冬行大冊禮。放進士張仲舉等四十五人。

In the ninth year of Tonghe, in the first spring month Song sent Liu Ping and Zhang Yuanpu with congratulations. In the second month the court went to Yuanyang Marsh. On gengwu day of the fifth month Yelü Zizhong returned from a mission to Goryeo; King Xun submitted a memorial asking to resume vassal status and tribute and to return the detained Liao envoy Zhilali. Zhilali had spent six years in Goryeo with loyal integrity unbroken and was made linya. On xinwei day envoys were dispatched to absolve King Xun and grant his request. On guiyou day Yelü Zongjiao was made Acting Grand Mentor, Zonghui Qisheng Army military commissioner, and Liu Sheng Crown Prince Grand Tutor, and all were granted the Meritorious Subject Who Preserves Integrity title. On the gengxu new moon of the seventh autumn month there was a solar eclipse; an edict ordered close ministers to perform sun-rescue rites on the Emperor's behalf. On jiayin day envoys were dispatched to grant Shazhou Uyghur Prince of Dunhuang Cao Shun clothing. Zhala, Geng Yuanji, Han Jiu, and Song Zhang were appointed chief and deputy envoys for the following year to congratulate Song on the Emperor's birthday and New Year's Day. On wuwu day of the ninth month imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong was appointed Associate Grand Chancellor. On dingmao day the civil and military hundred officials submitted a memorial offering an honorific title; permission was refused; after three submissions permission was granted. On yihai day Shazhou Uyghur Prince of Dunhuang Cao Shun sent envoys with tribute. Han civilian horses from all circuits were requisitioned for the eastern expedition army. Yilibi Yanning was appointed vice metropolitan horses-and-army garrison commander to command the eastern expedition. That month the court encamped at Jinping Marsh. Song sent Song Shou and Luo Jilun to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival. On the wuyin new moon of the tenth winter month Nieli was made Xi King inspector general and Tudieli Northern Prince's House Sheli Army xiangwen. Langjun Lao, envoy to Shazhou, returned, and an edict pardoned his accumulated punishments. By old custom when the state dispatched envoys to distant countries it often chose convicts who possessed talent and ability; when they returned, their crimes were remitted. On wuzi day the Southwestern Road pacification commissioner reported that among the Tangut tribes the Songxi clan had not delivered tribute on schedule and often harbored other intentions, and that envoys should be sent in season to supervise them. An edict said: "The petty tribes on the frontier owe annual fixed tribute. Frontier officials are arrogant and unrestrained and levy without limit; the tribes live in fear but cannot make themselves heard. Simply send upright and cautious officials and generals, show them favor and good faith, and let no one encroach or plunder, and they will naturally submit." They again reported that the Diju and Dieliede tribes said pacification commissioner Han Liu had governed benevolently and his term was now ending, and asked that he be retained. The Emperor ordered his record of governance submitted. On xinchou day the court went to the Central Capital. On renyin day the Dashi state sent envoys presenting an elephant and regional products and requesting a marriage alliance on behalf of Prince Zicege. On dingsi day of the eleventh month Qishui Commandery King Han Zhixin was appointed Nanjing regent, Xijin intendant, and supreme commander of troops and horses. On jiwei day yilibi Xiao Xiaoshun was made supreme commander of all Southern Route mobile palaces and promoted to Left Vice Director. On dinghai day of the twelfth month monks were forbidden to burn their bodies or char their fingers. On wuzi day an edict ordered construction of the Taizu temple at the Central Capital, with regulations and ritual vessels all following ancient standards. On yisi day an edict ordered that the great enfeoffment rite be performed the coming winter. Jinshi Zhang Zhongju and forty-five others passed the examinations.

太平元年春正月丁丑朔，宋使魯宗道、成吉來賀。如渾河。二月乙卯，幸鈸河。壬戌，獵高柳林。三月戊戌，皇子勃已只生。庚子，駙馬都尉蕭紹業建私城，賜名睦州，軍曰長慶。是月，大食國王復遣使請婚，封王子班郎君胡思裏女可老為公主，嫁之。夏四月戊申，東京留守奏，女直三十部酋長請各以其子詣闕祗候。詔與其父俱來受約。乙卯，錄囚。丁卯，置來州，是月，清暑緬山。秋七月甲戌朔，賜從獵女直人秋衣。乙亥，遣骨裏取石晉所上玉璽於中京。阻卜來貢。辛巳，如沙嶺。是月，獵潢河。九月，幸中京。冬十月丁未，敵烈酋長頗白來貢馬、駝。戊申，錄囚。壬子，宋使李懿、王仲賓來賀千齡節，及蘇惟甫、周鼎賀來歲元正，即遣蕭善、程翥報聘。党項長曷魯來貢。己未，以薩敏解裏為都點檢，高六副點檢，耶律羅漢奴左皮室詳穩，嗓姑右皮室詳穩，聊了西北路金吾，耶律僧隱御史大夫，求哥駙馬都尉，蕭舂、骨裏並大將軍。庚申，幸通天觀，觀魚龍曼衍之戲。翌日，再幸。還，升玉輅，自內三門入萬壽殿，奠酒七廟御容，因宴宗室。十一月癸未，上御昭慶殿，文武百僚奉冊上尊號曰睿文英武遵道至德崇仁廣孝功成治定昭聖神贊天輔皇帝，大赦，改元太平，中外官進級有差。宋遣使來聘，夏、高麗遣使來貢。甲申，冊皇子梁王宗真為皇太子。

In the first year of Taiping, on the dingchou new moon of the first spring month Song envoys Lu Zongdao and Cheng Ji came to offer congratulations. The court went to the Hun River. On yimao day of the second month the court visited the Bo River. On renxu day the court hunted at Gaoliu Forest. On wuxu day of the third month Prince Boyizhi was born. On gengzi day imperial son-in-law Commandant Xiao Shaoye built a private walled town that was granted the name Muzhou, with army designation Changqing. That month the King of Dashi again sent envoys requesting marriage; Prince Banlangjun Husili's daughter Kelao was enfeoffed as princess and married to him. On wushen day of the fourth summer month the Eastern Capital regent reported that chiefs of thirty Jurchen tribes each asked to send their sons to the court to wait on attendance. An edict ordered them to come with their fathers to receive covenant. On yimao day the court reviewed prisoners. On dingmao day Laizhou was established; that month the court took the summer retreat at Mianshan. On the jiaxu new moon of the seventh autumn month Jurchen who had accompanied the hunts were granted autumn garments. On yihai day Guli was sent to retrieve from the Central Capital the jade seal that Later Jin had presented. The Zubu came with tribute. On xinsi day the court went to Shaling. That month the court hunted on the Huang River. In the ninth month the court visited the Central Capital. On dingwei day of the tenth winter month Dilie chief Pobai came with tribute of horses and camels. On wushen day the court reviewed prisoners. On renzi day Song envoys Li Yi and Wang Zhongbin came to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival and Su Weifu and Zhou Ding to congratulate the coming New Year's Day; Xiao Shan and Cheng Zhu were immediately sent on a return mission. Tangut chief Helu came with tribute. On jiwei day Sa Minjieli was appointed supreme inspector, Gao Liu deputy inspector, Yelü Luohannu Left Pishi xiangwen, Sanggu Right Pishi xiangwen, Liaoliao Northwestern Route jinwu, Yelü Shengyin Censor-in-Chief, and Qiuge Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-law; Xiao Chun and Guli were both made great generals. On gengshen day the court visited Tongtian Observatory to watch dragon-and-fish aquatic performances. The next day the court visited again. On returning the Emperor ascended the jade carriage, entered Wanshou Hall through the inner three gates, offered wine before the imperial portraits of the seven temples, and then feasted the imperial clan. On guiwei day of the eleventh month the Emperor presided at Zhaqing Hall; civil and military officials presented the register and bestowed the honorific Sagaciously Cultured, Heroically Martial, Conforming to the Way, Utmost Virtue, Reverently Humane, Broadly Filial, Meritoriously Accomplished, Governingly Settled, Brilliantly Sage, Spiritually Praised, Heaven-Assisted Emperor; a grand amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed to Taiping, and officials at home and abroad were promoted in varying measure. Song dispatched envoys on a goodwill mission, and Xia and Goryeo sent envoys with tribute. On jiashen day Prince of Liang Zongzhen was invested as crown prince.

二年春正月，如納水釣魚。二月辛丑朔，駐蹕魚兒濼。三月甲戌，如長春州。丁丑，宋使薛貽廓來告宋主恒殂，子禎嗣位。遣都點檢耶律僧隱等充宋祭奠使副，林牙蕭日新、觀察馮延休充宋後吊慰使副。戊寅，遣金吾耶律諧領、引進姚居信充宋主吊慰使副。戊子，為宋主飯三京僧。是月，地震，雲、應二州屋摧地陷，嵬白山裂數百步，泉湧成流。夏四月，如緬山清暑。五月乙亥，參知政事石用中薨。庚辰，鐵驪遣使獻兀惹十六戶。六月己未，宋遣使薛由等來饋其先帝遺物。秋七月乙卯，以耶律信寧為奉陵軍節度使，高麗國參知政事王同顯靜海軍節度使，耶律遂忠長寧軍節度使，耿延毅昭德軍節度使，高守貞河西軍節度使。九月癸巳，遣尚書僧隱、韓格賀宋主即位。冬十月壬寅，遣堂後官張克恭充賀夏國王李德昭生日使，耶律掃古、韓王充賀宋太后生日使副，耶律仙寧、史克忠充賀宋正旦使副。是月，駐蹕胡魯古思澱。癸卯，賜宰臣呂德懋、參知政事吳叔達、樞密副使楊又玄、右丞相馬保忠錢物有差。辛亥，至上京，曲赦畿內囚。十一月丙戌，宋遣使來謝。十二月辛丑，高麗王詢薨，其子欽遣使來報，即命使冊欽為高麗國王。甲寅，宋遣劉燁、郭誌言來賀千齡節。是年，放進士張漸等四十七人。

In the second year, during the first spring month, the court fished at Nashui. On the xinchou new moon of the second month the court encamped at Yu'er Marsh. On jiaxu day of the third month the court went to Changchun Prefecture. On dingchou day Song envoy Xue Yikuo came announcing that Song Emperor Zhen had died and his son Zhen had succeeded. Supreme inspector Yelü Shengyin and others were sent as Song mourning sacrifice envoys, and linya Xiao Rixin and inspection commissioner Feng Yanxiu as Song post-funeral condolence envoys. On wuyin day jinwu Yelü Xieling and introducing commissioner Yao Juxin were sent as envoys to condole on the late Song emperor. On wuzi day monks in the three capitals were fed on behalf of the late Song emperor. That month an earthquake struck; in Yun and Ying prefectures houses collapsed and the ground sank; Mount Weibai split for several hundred paces and springs gushed forth into streams. In the fourth summer month the court went to Mianshan for the summer retreat. On yihai day of the fifth month Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner Shi Yongzhong died. On gengchen day Iron Li sent envoys presenting sixteen Wurang households. On jiwei day of the sixth month Song sent envoys including Xue You bearing keepsakes of the late emperor. On yimao day of the seventh autumn month Yelü Xinning was appointed military commissioner of the Fengling Army, Goryeo Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner Wang Tongxian military commissioner of the Jinghai Army, Yelü Suizhong military commissioner of the Changning Army, Geng Yanji military commissioner of the Zhaode Army, and Gao Shouzhen military commissioner of the Hexi Army. On guisi day of the ninth month Minister Yelü Shengyin and Han Ge were sent to congratulate the Song emperor on his accession. On renyin day of the tenth winter month palace rear official Zhang Kegong was sent to congratulate Western Xia King Li Dezhao on his birthday; Yelü Saogu and Han Wang to congratulate the Song empress dowager on her birthday; and Yelü Xianning and Shi Kezhong to congratulate Song on New Year's Day. That month the court encamped at Hulugusi Marsh. On guimao day Chief Minister Lü Demao, Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner Wu Shuda, Privy Council Vice Commissioner Yang Youxuan, and Right Chancellor Ma Baozhong were granted money and goods in varying measure. On xinhai day the court reached the Upper Capital and proclaimed a limited amnesty for prisoners within the capital district. On bingxu day of the eleventh month Song sent envoys to express thanks. On xinchou day of the twelfth month Goryeo King Xun died; his son Qin sent envoys to report it, and envoys were immediately ordered to invest Qin as King of Goryeo. On jiayin day Song sent Liu Ye and Guo Zhiyan to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival. That year jinshi Zhang Jian and forty-seven others passed the examinations.

三年春正月丙寅朔，如納水釣魚。以僧隱為平章事。乙亥，以蕭臺德為南王府都監，林牙耶律信寧西北路招討都監。辛巳，賜越國公主私城之名曰懿州，軍曰慶懿。二月丙申，以丁振為武信軍節度使，改封蘭陵郡王。戊申，以東平郡王蕭排押為西南面都招討，進封豳王。夏四月，以耶律守寧為都點檢。五月，清暑緬山。六月戊申，以南院宣徽使劉涇參知政事，蕭孝惠為副點檢，蕭孝恭東京統軍兼沿邊巡檢使。戊午，以蕭璉為左夷離畢，蕭琳為詳穩。秋七月戊寅，以南府宰相耶律合葛為上京留守，封漆水郡王。丙戌，以皇后生辰為順天節。丁亥，賜緬山名曰永安。是月，獵赤山。閏九月壬辰朔，以蕭柏達、韓紹雍充賀宋正旦使副，唐骨德、程昭文賀宋生辰使副。冬十月庚辰，宋遣薛奎、郭盛來賀順天節，王臻、慕容惟素賀千齡節。東征軍奏：「統帥諧領、常袞課奴率師自毛母國嶺入，林牙高九、裨將大匡逸等率師鼓山嶺入。閏月未至撻離河，不遇敵而還。以是月會於弘怕只嶺，駝馬死者甚眾。」駐蹕遼河。十一月辛卯朔，以皇侄宗範為歸德軍節度使，北府宰相蕭孝穆南京留守，封燕王，南京留守韓制心南院大王、兵馬都總管，仇正燕京轉運使。十二月壬戌，以宗範為平章事，封三韓郡王，仇道衡中京副留守，馮延休順州刺史。郎玄化西山轉運使，趙其樞密直學士。丁卯，以蕭永為太子太師。己卯，封皇子重元秦國王。

In the third year, on the bingyin new moon of the first spring month the court fished at Nashui. Yelü Shengyin was appointed Political Affairs Commissioner. On yihai day Xiao Taide was appointed Southern Palace supreme supervisor and linya Yelü Xinning Northwestern Route pacification supreme supervisor. On xinsi day the private walled town of the Princess of Yue was granted the name Yizhou, with army designation Qingyi. On bingshen day of the second month Ding Zhen was appointed military commissioner of the Wuxin Army and his fief was changed to Prince of Lanling Commandery. On wushen day Eastern Plain Commandery King Xiao Paiya was appointed Southwestern Route supreme pacification commissioner and advanced to King of Bin. In the fourth summer month Yelü Shouning was appointed supreme inspector. In the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Mianshan. On wushen day of the sixth month Southern Court xuanhui commissioner Liu Jing was appointed associate administrative affairs commissioner; Xiao Xiaohui was made deputy inspector; and Xiao Xiaogong was made Eastern Capital commander and concurrent frontier inspection commissioner. On wuwu day Xiao Lian was appointed Left yilibi and Xiao Lin xiangwen. On wuyin day of the seventh autumn month Southern Chancellery chancellor Yelü Hege was appointed Upper Capital regent and enfeoffed as Qishui Commandery King. On bingxu day the Empress's birthday was established as Shuntian Festival. On dinghai day Mianshan was granted the name Yong'an. That month the court hunted at Chishan. On the renchen new moon of the intercalary ninth month Xiao Baida and Han Shaoyong were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day, and Tang Gude and Cheng Zhaowen as envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor's birthday. On gengchen day of the tenth winter month Song sent Xue Kui and Guo Sheng to congratulate the Shuntian Festival and Wang Zhen and Murong Weisu to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival. The Eastern Expedition Army reported: "Commander Xieling and Changgun Kenu led troops in from Maomuguo Ridge, and linya Gao Jiu, subordinate general Da Kuangyi, and others led troops in from Gushan Ridge. In the intercalary month they had not yet reached Talu River when they returned without encountering the enemy. They rendezvoused at Hongpazhi Ridge that month, and very many camels and horses died." The court encamped on the Liao River. On the xinmao new moon of the eleventh month Imperial Nephew Zongfan was appointed military commissioner of the Guide Army; Northern Chancellery chancellor Xiao Xiaomu was made Nanjing regent and enfeoffed as King of Yan; Nanjing regent Han Zhixin was made Southern Court Great King and supreme commander of troops and horses; and Qiu Zheng was made Yanjing transport commissioner. On renxu day of the twelfth month Zongfan was appointed Political Affairs Commissioner and enfeoffed as Prince of Three Han Commandery; Qiu Daoheng was made Central Capital deputy regent; and Feng Yanxiu was made prefect of Shunzhou. Lang Xuanhua was appointed Western Mountains transport commissioner and Zhao Qi Privy Direct Academician. On dingmao day Xiao Yong was appointed Crown Prince Grand Preceptor. On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.

四年春正月庚寅朔，宋遣張傳、張士禹、程琳、丁保衡來賀。如鴨子河。二月己未朔，獵撻魯河。詔改鴨子河曰混同江，撻魯河曰長春河。三月戊子朔，千齡節，詔賜諸宮分耆老食。夏四月癸酉，以右丞相馬保忠之子世弘使嶺表，至平地松林，為盜所殺，特贈昭信軍節度使。五月，清暑永安山。六月己未，南院大王韓制心薨。戊辰，以鄭弘節為兵部郎中，劉慎行順義軍節度使。辛未，以燕王蕭孝穆子順為千牛衛將軍。甲戌，以中山郡王查哥為保靜軍節度使，樂安郡王遂哥廣德軍節度使，蕭解裏彰德軍節度使。庚辰，以遼興軍節度使周王胡都古為臨海軍節度使，漆水郡王敵烈南院大王。秋七月，如秋山。八月丙辰朔，以韓紹芳為樞密直學士，駙馬蕭匹敵都點檢。九月，以駙馬蕭紹宗為武定軍節度使，耶律宗福安國軍節度使。冬十月，駐蹕遼河。宋遣蔡齊、李用和來賀千齡節。十一月，追封南院大王韓制心為陳王。十二月，以蕭從政為歸義軍節度使，康筠監門衛，充賀宋正旦使副。是年，放進士李訁恣等四十七人。

In the fourth year, on the gengyin new moon of the first spring month Song sent Zhang Chuan, Zhang Shiyu, Cheng Lin, and Ding Baoheng to offer congratulations. The court went to the Yazi River. On the jiwei new moon of the second month the court hunted on the Talu River. An edict renamed the Yazi River Huntun River and the Talu River Changchun River. On the wuzi new moon of the third month, the Thousand Age Festival, an edict granted food to elders in the various palace establishments. On guiyou day of the fourth summer month Right Chancellor Ma Baozhong's son Shihong was sent on a mission beyond the passes; reaching Pingdi Pine Forest he was killed by bandits and was specially posthumously granted military commissioner of the Zhaoxin Army. In the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Mount Yong'an. On jiwei day of the sixth month Southern Court Great King Han Zhixin died. On wuchen day Zheng Hongjie was appointed bureau director in the Ministry of War and Liu Shenxing military commissioner of the Shunyi Army. On xinwei day Yan King Xiao Xiaomu's son Shun was appointed general of the Qianniu Guard. On jiaxu day Prince of Zhongshan Zhage was appointed military commissioner of the Baojing Army, Prince of Le'an Suige military commissioner of the Guangde Army, and Xiao Jieli military commissioner of the Zhangde Army. On gengchen day Prince Zhou Hu Dugu was transferred from the Liaoxing Army to the Linhai Army, and Qishui Commandery Prince Di Lie was appointed Southern Court great king. In the seventh autumn month the court went to Autumn Mountain. On the bingchen new moon of the eighth month Han Shaofang was appointed Privy Council direct scholar and imperial son-in-law Xiao Pidi chief inspector. In the ninth month imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong was appointed military commissioner of the Wuding Army and Yelü Zongfu military commissioner of the An'guo Army. In the tenth winter month the court encamped at the Liao River. Song sent Cai Qi and Li Yonghe to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival. In the eleventh month Southern Court great king Han Zhixin was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Chen. In the twelfth month Xiao Congzheng was appointed military commissioner of the Guiyi Army and Kang Jun, gate guard, was made deputy envoy to congratulate Song on New Year's Day. That year Li Zisi and forty-seven others passed the examinations.
017: 五年春正月乙酉，如混同江。二月戊午，禁天下服用明金及金線綺；國親當服者，奏而後用。是月，如魚兒濼。三月壬辰，以左丞相張儉為武定軍節度使、同政事門下平章事，鄭弘節臨潢少尹，劉慎行遼興軍節度使，武定軍節度使蕭匹敵契丹行宮都部署，樞密副使楊又玄吏部尚書、參知政事兼樞密使。是月，如長春河魚兒濼，其水一夕有聲如雷，越沙岡四十里，別為一陂。夏五月，清暑永安山。以蕭從順為太子太師，吳叔達翰林學士，道士馮若谷加太子中允，耶律晨武定軍節度使，張儉彰信軍節度使，呂士宗禮部員外郎，李可舉順義軍節度使。秋七月，獵平地松林。九月，駐蹕南京。己亥，以蕭迪烈、李紹琪充賀宋太后生辰使副，耶律守寧、劉四端充賀宋主生辰使副。冬十月辛未，宋太后遣馮元宗、史方來賀順天節。十一月庚子，幸內果園宴，京民聚觀。求進士，得七十二人，命賦詩，第其工拙，以張昱等一十四人為太子校書郎，韓欒等五十八人為崇文館校書郎。辛丑，以左祗候郎君詳穩蕭羅羅為右夷離畢。十二月丁巳，以漢人行宮都部署蕭孝先為上京留守，皇侄長沙郡王謝家奴匡義軍節度使，耶律仁舉興國軍節度使。甲子，蕭守寧為點檢侍衛親軍馬步軍。乙丑，北院樞密使蕭合卓薨。戊辰，以北府宰相蕭普古為北院樞密使。己巳，遣蕭諧、李琪充賀宋正旦使副。庚午，以參知政事劉京為順義軍節度使。乙亥，宋使李維、張綸來賀千齡節。是歲，燕民以年谷豐熟，車駕臨幸，爭以土物來獻。上禮高年，惠鰥寡，賜酺飲。至夕，六街燈火如晝，士庶嬉遊，上亦微行觀之。丁丑，禁工匠不得銷毀金銀器。

In the fifth year of Taiping, on yiyou day of the first spring month the court went to Hun River. On wuwu day of the second month bright gold and gold-thread brocade were forbidden throughout the realm; imperial clansmen who were entitled to wear them had to memorialize before use. That month the court went to Yu'er Marsh. On renchen day of the third month Left Grand Chancellor Zhang Jian was appointed Wuding Army military commissioner and Associate Political Affairs Commissioner; Zheng Hongjie was made Linhuang vice prefect; Liu Shenxing Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Wuding Army military commissioner Xiao Pide Khitan palace metropolitan garrison commander; and Privy Vice Commissioner Yang Youxuan Minister of Personnel, Associate Political Affairs Commissioner, and concurrent Privy Commissioner. That month the court went to Changchun River Yu'er Marsh, where the waters overnight roared like thunder, crossed sand ridges forty li, and formed a separate pond. In the fifth summer month the court took the summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain. Xiao Congshun was appointed Crown Prince Grand Preceptor; Wu Shuda Hanlin Academician; Daoist Feng Ruogu was promoted to Crown Prince Palace Companion; Yelü Chen Wuding Army military commissioner; Zhang Jian Zhangxin Army military commissioner; Lü Shizong Assistant Director of Rites; and Li Keju Shunyi Army military commissioner.
