In the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest. In the ninth month the court encamped at the Southern Capital. On jihai day Xiao Dilie and Li Shaoqi were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Empress Dowager on her birthday, and Yelü Shouning and Liu Siduan chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Emperor on his birthday. On xinwei day of the tenth winter month the Song Empress Dowager sent Feng Yuanzong and Shi Fang to congratulate the Shuntian Festival. On gengzi day of the eleventh month the court visited the inner orchard for a banquet, and people of the capital gathered to watch. Jinshi examinations were held and seventy-two candidates were selected; they were ordered to compose poetry and were ranked by skill; Zhang Yu and thirteen others were appointed Crown Prince proofreaders, and Han Luan and fifty-eight others Chongwenguan proofreaders. On xinchou day Left Guard attendant langjun xiangwen Xiao Luoluo was appointed Right yilibi. On dingsi day of the twelfth month Han Chinese palace metropolitan garrison commander Xiao Xiaoxian was appointed Upper Capital regent; imperial nephew Prince of Changsha Xiejianu Kuangyi Army military commissioner; and Yelü Renju Xingguo Army military commissioner. On jiazi day Xiao Shouning was appointed Palace Front inspector general of the imperial guard horse and foot. On yichou day Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Hezhuo died. On wuchen day Northern Chancellor Xiao Pugu was appointed Northern Privy Commissioner. On jisi day Xiao Xie and Li Qi were dispatched as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day. On gengwu day Associate Political Affairs Commissioner Liu Jing was appointed Shunyi Army military commissioner. On yihai day Song envoys Li Wei and Zhang Lun came to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival. That year, because the grain harvest in Yan was abundant, when the imperial carriage visited the people competed to offer local products. The Emperor honored the aged, benefited widows and orphans, and granted communal drinking. By evening the lamps of the six streets shone bright as day; gentry and common people amused themselves, and the Emperor also went incognito to watch. On dingchou day artisans were forbidden to destroy gold and silver vessels.

六年春正月己卯朔，宋遣徐奭、裴繼起、張若谷、崔準來賀。庚辰，如鴛鴦濼。二月己酉，以迷離己同知樞密院，黃翩為兵馬都部署，達骨只副之，赦石為都監，引軍城混同江、疏木河之間。黃龍府請建堡障三、烽臺十，詔以農隙築之。東京留守八哥奏黃翩領兵入女直界徇地，俘獲人、馬、牛、豕，不可勝計，得降戶二百七十，詔獎諭之。戊午，以耶律野為副點檢，以國舅帳蕭柳氏、徒魯骨領西北路十二班軍、奚王府舍利軍。己巳，南京水，遣使振之。庚午，詔党項別部塌西設契丹節度使治之。三月戊寅朔，以大同軍節度使張儉入為南院樞密使、左丞相兼政事令，參知政事吳叔達責授將作少監，出為東州刺史。是月，阻卜來侵，西北路招討使蕭惠破之。夏四月丁未朔，以武定軍節度使耶律洪古為惕隱。戊申，蒲盧毛朵部多兀惹戶，詔索之。丙寅，如永安山。五月辛卯，以東京統軍使蕭慥古為契丹行宮都部署。癸卯，遣西北路招討使蕭惠將兵伐甘州回鶻。六月辛丑，詔凡官畜並印其左以識之。秋七月戊申，獵黑嶺。八月，蕭惠攻甘州不克，師還。自是阻卜諸部皆叛，遼軍與戰，皆為所敗，監軍涅裏姑、國舅帳太保曷不呂死之。詔遣惕隱耶律洪古、林牙化哥等將兵討之。九月，駐蹕遼河滸。冬十月丙子，曷蘇館諸部長來朝。庚辰，遣使問夏國五月與宋交戰之故。辛巳，以前院大王直魯袞為烏古敵烈都詳穩。庚寅，以蕭孝順、蕭紹宗兼侍中，駙馬蕭紹業平章政事，前南院大王胡睹堇同知上京留守，安哥通化州節度使。十一月乙丑，宋遣韓翼、田承說來賀順天節。戊辰，西北路招討司小校掃姑訴招討蕭惠三罪，詔都監奧骨禎按之。十二月庚辰，曷蘇館部乞建旗鼓，許之。辛巳，詔北南諸部廉察州縣及石烈、彌裏之官，不治者罷之。詔大小職官有貪暴殘民者，立罷之，終身不錄；其不廉直，雖處重任，即代之；能清勤自持者，在卑位亦當薦拔；其內族受賂，事發，與常人所犯同科。戊戌，遣杜防、蕭蘊充賀宋生辰使副。庚子，駐蹕遼河。

In the sixth year of Taiping, on the jimao new moon of the first spring month Song sent Xu Shi, Pei Jiji, Zhang Ruogu, and Cui Zhun with congratulations. On gengchen day the court went to Yuanyang Marsh. On jiyou day of the second month Miliji was appointed Associate Privy Commissioner; Huang Pian was made army cavalry commander with Dabguzhi as vice and Sheshi as overseer, and led troops to fortify the area between Hun River and Shumu River. Huanglong Prefecture requested three fortifications and ten beacon towers; an edict ordered them built during farming intervals. Eastern Capital regent Bage reported that Huang Pian had led troops into Jurchen territory to raid, capturing people, horses, cattle, and pigs beyond counting and receiving two hundred seventy surrendering households; an edict praised and instructed him. On wuwu day Yelü Ye was appointed deputy inspector; Imperial Uncle's Household Xiao Liushi and Tulügu were put in charge of the Northwestern Route Twelve-Ban Army and the Xi Prince's House Sheli Army. On jisi day the Southern Capital flooded, and envoys were dispatched to provide relief. On gengwu day an edict ordered the Tangut sub-tribe Taxi to establish a Khitan military commissioner to govern them. On the wuyin new moon of the third month Datong Army military commissioner Zhang Jian entered service as Southern Privy Commissioner, Left Grand Chancellor, and Political Affairs Commissioner; Associate Political Affairs Commissioner Wu Shuda was demoted to Assistant Director of Palace Construction and sent out as Dongzhou prefect. That month the Zubu invaded, and Northwestern Route pacification commissioner Xiao Hui defeated them. On the dingwei new moon of the fourth summer month Wuding Army military commissioner Yelü Honggu was appointed tiyin. On wushen day the Puloumaoduo tribe had many Wuren households; an edict ordered them surrendered. On bingyin day the court went to Yong'an Mountain. On xinmao day of the fifth month Eastern Capital army commander Xiao Kaogu was appointed Khitan palace metropolitan garrison commander. On guimao day Northwestern Route pacification commissioner Xiao Hui was dispatched to lead troops against the Ganzhou Uighurs. On xinchou day of the sixth month an edict ordered all official livestock branded on the left for identification. On wushen day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Heiling. In the eighth month Xiao Hui attacked Ganzhou without success and the army returned. From this the Zubu tribes all rebelled; Liao armies fought them and were all defeated; overseer Nieligu and Imperial Uncle's Household Grand Guardian Habülü were killed. An edict dispatched tiyin Yelü Honggu, linya Huage, and others to lead troops against them. In the ninth month the court encamped at the Liao River bank. On bingzi day of the tenth winter month chiefs of the Yasuguan tribes came to court. On gengchen day envoys were dispatched to inquire into the reason Xia State had fought Song in the fifth month. On xinsi day former Southern Great King Zhilugun was appointed chief xiangwen of Ugu and Dilie. On gengyin day Xiao Xiaoshun and Xiao Shaozong were appointed concurrent Palace Attendants; imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaoye Political Affairs Commissioner; former Southern Great King Huzhijin Associate Upper Capital regent; and Ange Tonghua Prefecture military commissioner. On yichou day of the eleventh month Song sent Han Yi and Tian Chengshuo to congratulate the Shuntian Festival. On wuchen day Northwestern Route pacification office sergeant Saogu accused pacification commissioner Xiao Hui of three crimes; an edict ordered overseer Aoguzhen to investigate. On gengchen day of the twelfth month the Yasuguan tribe requested to establish banners and drums; permission was granted. On xinsi day an edict ordered officials of north and south tribes inspecting prefectures and counties and shilie and mili posts who did not govern well to be dismissed. An edict ordered that officials great and small who were greedy, violent, and harmed the people be immediately dismissed and never again recorded; those who were not upright, even if holding heavy office, were to be replaced at once; those who were clean and diligent in self-restraint, even in low office, should also be recommended and promoted; members of the imperial clan who accepted bribes, when discovered, were to be punished under the same statute as common offenders. On wuxu day Du Fang and Xiao Yun were dispatched as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on the Emperor's birthday. On gengzi day the court encamped at the Liao River.

七年春正月壬寅朔，宋遣張保維、孫繼業、孔道輔、馬崇至來賀。如混同江。辛亥，以女直白縷為惕隱，蒲馬為巖母部太師。甲寅，蒲盧毛朵部遣使來貢。夏四月乙未，獵黑嶺。五月，清暑永安山。西南路招討司奏陰山中產金銀，請置冶，從之。復遣使循遼河源求產金銀之礦。六月，禁諸屯田不得擅貨官粟。癸巳，詔蕭惠再討阻卜。秋七月己亥朔，詔更定法令。庚子，詔諭駙馬蕭鉏不、公主粘米袞：「爾於後有父母之尊，後或臨幸，祗謁先祖，祗拜空帳，失致敬之禮，今後可設像拜謁。」乙巳，詔輦路所經，旁三十步內不得耕種者，不在訴訟之限。九月，駐蹕遼河。冬十月丁卯朔，詔諸帳院庶孽，並從其母論貴賤。十一月，宋遣石中立、石貽孫來賀千齡節，王博文、王雙賀順天節。辛亥，以楊又玄、邢祥知貢舉。己未，匡義軍節度使中山郡王查葛、保寧軍節度使長沙郡王謝家奴、廣德軍節度使樂安郡王遂哥奏，各將之官，乞選伴讀書史，從之。癸亥，以三韓王欽為啟聖軍節度使，楊佶刑部侍郎。甲子，以左千牛衛上將軍耶律古昱為北院大王。十二月丁卯朔，遣耶律遂英、王永錫充賀宋太后生辰，蕭速撒、馬保永充賀正旦使副。癸酉，以金吾蕭高六為奚舍利軍詳穩。

In the seventh year of Taiping, on the renyin new moon of the first spring month Song sent Zhang Baowei, Sun Jiye, Kong Daofu, and Ma Chongzhi with congratulations. The court went to Hun River. On xinhai day Jurchen Bailü was appointed tiyin and Puma Grand Preceptor of the Yanmu tribe. On jiayin day the Puloumaoduo tribe sent envoys with tribute. On yiwei day of the fourth summer month the court hunted at Heiling. In the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain. The Southwestern Route pacification office reported that the Yin Mountains produced gold and silver and requested a smeltery; approval was granted. Envoys were again dispatched along the Liao River source to seek mines producing gold and silver. In the sixth month all military colonies were forbidden to privately sell official grain. On guisi day an edict ordered Xiao Hui to campaign against the Zubu again. On the jihai new moon of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered laws and regulations revised. On gengzi day an edict instructed imperial son-in-law Xiao Cubu and Princess Nianmigun: "You will afterward have the status of parents; when the Empress visits in future and you reverently attend the ancestral spirits, reverently bowing before empty tents falls short of the rite of respect; hereafter you may set up portraits and bow before them. " On yisi day an edict ordered that land within thirty paces on either side of the imperial carriage route that might not be cultivated was not subject to litigation. In the ninth month the court encamped at the Liao River. On the dingmao new moon of the tenth winter month an edict ordered all tent-palace illegitimate offspring to follow their mothers in rank. In the eleventh month Song sent Shi Zhongli and Shi Yisun to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival and Wang Bowen and Wang Shuang to congratulate the Shuntian Festival. On xinhai day Yang Youxuan and Xing Xiang were appointed examination supervisors. On jiwei day Kuangyi Army military commissioner Prince of Zhongshan Zhage, Baoning Army military commissioner Prince of Changsha Xiejianu, and Guangde Army military commissioner Prince of Le'an Suige memorialized that as each was about to take up his post he requested companions versed in history; permission was granted. On guihai day Three Han Prince Qin was appointed Qisheng Army military commissioner and Yang Ji Vice Minister of Justice. On jiazi day Left Thousand-Ox Guard senior general Yelü Guyü was appointed Northern Great King. On the dingmao new moon of the twelfth month Yelü Suiying and Wang Yongxi were dispatched as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Empress Dowager on her birthday, and Xiao Susa and Ma Baoyong as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day. On guiyou day jinwu guard Xiao Gaoliu was appointed Xi Sheli Army xiangwen.

八年春正月乙亥，如混同江。庚申，党項侵邊，破之。甲子，詔州縣長吏勸農。二月戊子，燕京留守蕭孝穆乞於拒馬河接宋境上置戍長巡察，詔從之。三月，駐蹕長春河。夏五月，清暑永安山。六月，以韓寧、劉湘充賀宋太后生辰使副，吳克荷充賀夏國王李德昭生辰使。癸巳，權北院大王耶律鄭留奏，今歲十一月皇太子納妃，諸族備會親之帳。詔以豪盛者三十戶給其費。秋七月丁酉，以遙輦帳郎君陳哥為西北路巡檢，與蕭諧領同管二招討地。以南院大王耶律敵烈為上京留守。戊戌，獵平地松林。九月壬辰朔，以渤海宰相羅漢權東京統軍使。壬子，幸中京。北敵烈部節度使耶律延壽請視諸部，賜旗鼓，詔從之。癸丑，阻卜別部長胡懶來降。乙卯，阻卜長舂古來降。冬十月，宋遣唐肅、葛懷湣來賀順天節。樞密使、魏王耶律斜軫孫婦阿聒指斥乘輿，其孫骨欲為之隱，事覺，乃並坐之，仍籍其家。詔燕城將士，若敵至，總管備城之東南，統軍守其西北，馬步軍備其野戰，統軍副使繕壁壘，課士卒，各練其事。十一月丙申，皇太子納妃蕭氏。以耶律求翰為北院大王十二月辛酉朔，以遙輦太尉謝佛留為天雲軍詳穩。壬申，以前北院大王耶律留寧為雙州節度使，康筠崇德宮都部署，謝十永興宮都部署，旅墳宜州節度使，菴遼州節度使，耶律野同知中京留守，耶律曷魯突愧為大將軍。丁丑，詔庶孽雖已為良，不得預世選。丁亥，宋遣寇瑊、康德來賀千齡節。朱諫、曹英、張逸、劉永釗賀來歲兩宮正旦。詔兩國舅及南、北王府乃國之貴族，賤庶不得任本部官。是歲，放進士張宥等五十七人。

In the eighth year of Taiping, on yihai day of the first spring month the court went to Hun River. On gengshen day the Tangut invaded the border and were defeated. On jiazi day an edict ordered prefectural and county chief officials to encourage agriculture. On wuzi day of the second month Yanjing regent Xiao Xiaomu requested guard posts on the Juma River at the Song border for patrol; an edict approved. In the third month the court encamped at Changchun River. In the fifth summer month the court took the summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain. In the sixth month Han Ning and Liu Xiang were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Empress Dowager on her birthday, and Wu Kehe envoy to congratulate Xia King Li Dezhao on his birthday. On guisi day Acting Northern Great King Yelü Zhengliu reported that in the eleventh month of this year the Crown Prince would take a consort and the tribes should prepare marriage-reception tents. An edict ordered thirty wealthy households to supply the expenses. On dingyou day of the seventh autumn month Yaolian tent langjun Chenge was appointed Northwestern Route inspector, jointly with Xiao Xie to administer the two pacification territories. Southern Great King Yelü Dilie was appointed Upper Capital regent. On wuxu day the court hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest. On the renchen new moon of the ninth month Bohai chancellor Luohan was appointed acting Eastern Capital army commander. On renzi day the court visited the Central Capital. Bei Dilie tribe military commissioner Yelü Yanshou requested to inspect the tribes and was granted banners and drums; an edict approved. On guichou day Zubu sub-tribe chief Hulan came to surrender. On yimao day Zubu chief Chungu submitted. In the tenth winter month Song sent Tang Su and Ge Huaimin to congratulate the Shuntian Festival. Privy Council commissioner and King of Wei Yelü Xiezhi's grandson's wife Awu reviled the imperial carriage; his grandson Guyu tried to conceal it; when the matter came out both were punished and their household was confiscated. An edict to Yan city officers and soldiers ordered that if the enemy arrives the garrison commander is to secure the southeast of the city, the supreme commander the northwest, cavalry and infantry to prepare for field battle, and the deputy supreme commander to repair walls and ramparts and drill troops, each training for his task. On bingshen day of the eleventh month the crown prince took consort the Xiao clan. Yelü Qiuhan was appointed Northern Court king; on the xinyou new moon of the twelfth month Yaolian grand marshal Xie Foliu was made Tianyun Army xiangwen. On renshen day former Northern Court king Yelü Liuning was appointed Shuang Prefecture military commissioner; Kang Jun was made Chongde Palace metropolitan garrison commander; Xie Shi Yongxing Palace metropolitan garrison commander; Lü Fen Yizhou military commissioner; An Liaozhou military commissioner; Yelü Ye concurrent Central Capital regent; and Yelü Helutu kui great general. On dingchou day an edict declared that though base-born offspring may have become commoners, they may not participate in household selection. On dinghai day Song sent Kou Zhen and Kang De to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival. Zhu Jian, Cao Ying, Zhang Yi, and Liu Yongzhao were to congratulate both palaces on New Year's Day of the coming year. An edict declared that the two imperial maternal uncles and the Southern and Northern Princes' Households are the state's nobility and that low-born commoners may not hold offices in those households. That year fifty-seven jinshi including Zhang You passed the examinations.

九年春正月，至自中京。二月戊辰，遣使賜高麗王欽物。如斡凜河。夏五月，清暑永安山。六月戊子朔，以長沙郡王謝家奴為廣德軍節度使，樂安郡王遂哥匡義軍節度使，中山郡王查葛保定軍節度使，進封潞王，豫章王貼不長寧軍節度使。以耶律思忠、耶律荷、耶律暠、遙輦謝佛留、陳邈、韓紹一、韓知白、張震充賀宋兩宮生辰及來歲正旦使副。秋七月戊午朔，如黑嶺。八月己丑，東京舍利軍詳穩大延琳囚留守駙馬都尉蕭孝先及南陽公主，殺戶部使韓紹勛、副使王嘉、四捷軍都指揮使蕭頗得，延琳遂僭位，號其國為興遼，年為天慶。初，東遼之地，自神冊來附，未有榷酤鹽曲之法，關市之征亦甚寬弛。馮延休、韓紹勛相繼以燕地平山之法繩之，民不堪命。燕又仍歲大饑，戶部副使王嘉復獻計造船，使其民諳海事者，漕粟以賑燕民。水路艱險，多至覆沒，雖言不信，鞭楚搒掠，民怨思亂。故延琳乘之，首殺紹勛、嘉，以快其眾。延琳先事與副留守王道平謀，道平夜棄其家，逾城走，與延琳所遣召黃龍府黃翩者，俱至行在告變。上即征諸道兵，以時進討。時國舅詳穩蕭匹敵治近延琳，先率本管及家兵據其要害，絕其西渡之計。渤海太保夏行美亦舊主兵，戍保州，延林密馳書，使圖統帥耶律蒲古。行美乃以實告，蒲古得書，遂殺渤海兵八百人，而斷其東路。延琳知黃龍、保州皆不附，遂分兵西取沈州，其節度使蕭王六初至，其副張傑聲言欲降，故不急攻。及知其詐，而已有備，攻之不克而還。時南、北女直皆從延琳，高麗亦稽其貢。及諸道兵次第皆至，延琳嬰城固守。冬十月丙戌朔，以南京留守燕王蕭孝穆為都統，國舅詳穩蕭匹敵為副統，奚六部大王蕭蒲奴為都監以討之。十一月乙卯朔，如顯陵。丙寅，以沈州節度副使張傑為節度使，其皇城進士張人紀、趙睦等二十二人入朝。試以詩賦，皆賜第，超授保州戍將夏行美平章事。壬申，以駙馬劉四端權知宣徽南院事。十二月丁未，宋遣仇永、韓永錫來賀千齡節。命耶律育、吳克荷、蕭可觀、趙利用充賀宋生辰使副，耶律元吉、崔閏、蕭昭古、竇振充來歲賀宋正旦使副。

In the ninth year, during the first spring month, the court returned from the Central Capital. On wuchen day of the second month envoys were sent to bestow goods on Goryeo King Qin. The court went to Galin River. In the fifth summer month the court took the summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain. On the wuzi new moon of the sixth month Changsha Commandery King Xiejianu was appointed Guangde Army military commissioner; Le'an Commandery King Suige Kuangyi Army military commissioner; Zhongshan Commandery King Zhage Baoding Army military commissioner and advanced to King of Lu; and Yuzhang King Tiebu Changning Army military commissioner. Yelü Sizhong, Yelü He, Yelü Hao, Yaolian Xie Foliu, Chen Miao, Han Shaoyi, Han Zhibai, and Zhang Zhen were appointed envoys to congratulate both Song palaces on their birthdays and on New Year's Day of the coming year. On the wuwu new moon of the seventh autumn month the court went to Black Ridge. On jichou day of the eighth month Eastern Capital Sheli Army xiangwen Da Yanlin imprisoned regent imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Xiaoxian and Nanyang Princess, killed Revenue Commissioner Han Shaoxun, deputy commissioner Wang Jia, and Four Expeditions Army commander-in-chief Xiao Piede; Yanlin then usurped the throne, called his state Xingliao, and took the era name Tianqing. Initially in Eastern Liaodong territory, since coming under allegiance at Shence there had been no monopoly sale of salt or yeast, and market tolls at passes were also very lax. Feng Yanxiu and Han Shaoxun successively applied Yan's Ping Mountains regulations to constrain them, and the people could not bear it. Yan again suffered famine year after year; Revenue Deputy Commissioner Wang Jia again proposed building ships and having locals skilled in maritime affairs transport grain by water to relieve the people of Yan. Water routes were perilous and many ships sank; though people spoke of it they were not believed, and whipping, beating, and plunder followed until the people resented and thought of rebellion. Therefore Yanlin seized the opportunity, first killing Shaoxun and Jia to satisfy his followers. Yanlin had earlier plotted with deputy regent Wang Daoping; Daoping abandoned his family at night and fled over the wall, and together with Huang Pian, whom Yanlin had sent to summon from Huanglong Prefecture, both reached the mobile court to report the uprising. The Emperor immediately mobilized forces from all routes to advance and suppress in season. At the time imperial maternal uncle xiangwen Xiao Pide was stationed near Yanlin; he first led his command and household troops to seize strategic points, cutting off Yanlin's plan to cross west. Bohai Grand Guardian Xia Xingmei had also formerly commanded troops and garrisoned Ba Prefecture; Yanlin secretly sent a fast letter asking him to plot against commander Yelü Pugu. Xingmei then reported the truth; Pugu received the letter and killed eight hundred Bohai troops, cutting off the eastern route. Yanlin knew that Huanglong and Ba Prefecture would not join him, so he divided his forces west to take Shen Prefecture; its military commissioner Xiao Wangliu had just arrived, and his deputy Zhang Jie declared he wished to surrender, so they did not press the attack. When they learned it was a ruse the defenders were already prepared; they attacked but could not take the city and withdrew. At the time both Southern and Northern Jurchen followed Yanlin, and Goryeo also delayed its tribute. When forces from all routes arrived in succession, Yanlin defended the city stubbornly. On the bingxu new moon of the tenth winter month Nanjing regent Prince of Yan Xiao Xiaomu was appointed supreme commander, imperial maternal uncle xiangwen Xiao Pide deputy supreme commander, and Xi Six Tribes king Xiao Punu inspector general to suppress him. On the yimao new moon of the eleventh month the court went to Xianling. On bingyin day Shen Prefecture military deputy commissioner Zhang Jie was appointed military commissioner, and twenty-two imperial city jinshi including Zhang Renji and Zhao Mu entered court. They were tested with poetry and prose; all were granted ranks, and Ba Prefecture garrison commander Xia Xingmei was exceptionally appointed Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner. On renshen day imperial son-in-law Liu Siduan was appointed acting supervisor of the Southern Court Xuanhui Bureau. On dingwei day of the twelfth month Song sent Qiu Yong and Han Yongxi to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival. Yelü Yu, Wu Kehe, Xiao Keguan, and Zhao Liyong were ordered as Song birthday envoys, and Yelü Yuanji, Cui Run, Xiao Zhaogu, and Dou Zhen as New Year's Day envoys for the coming year.

十年春正月乙卯朔，宋遣王夷簡、竇處約、張易、張士宜來賀。二月，幸龍化州。三月甲寅朔，詳穩蕭匹敵至自遼東，言都統蕭孝穆去城四面各五里許，築城堡以圍之。駙馬延寧與其妹穴地遁去，惟公主崔八在後，為守陴者覺而止。夏四月，如乾陵。以耶律行平為廣平軍節度使，夏行美為忠順軍節度使，李延弘知易州，蕭從順加太子太師。五月戊申，清暑柏坡。秋七月壬午，詔來歲行貢舉法。八月丙午，東京賊將楊詳世密送款，夜開南門納遼軍。擒延琳，渤海平。冬十月，駐蹕長寧澱。十一月辛亥，南京留守燕王蕭孝穆以東征將士凱還，戎服見上，上大加宴勞。翌日，以孝穆為東平王、東京留守，國舅詳穩、駙馬都尉蕭匹敵封蘭陵郡王，奚王蒲奴加侍中；以權燕京留守兼侍中蕭惠為燕京統軍使，前統軍委窊大將軍、節度使，宰相兼樞密使馬保忠權知燕京留守，奚王府都監蕭阿古軫東京統軍使。詔渤海舊族有勛勞材力者敘用，餘分居來、隰、遷、潤等州。十二月乙巳，宋遣梅詢、王令傑來賀千齡節。漆水郡王耶律敵烈加尚父，烏古部節度使蕭普達為乙室部大王，尚書左僕射蕭琳為臨海軍節度使。

In the tenth year, on the yimao new moon of the first spring month, Song sent Wang Yijian, Dou Chuyue, Zhang Yi, and Zhang Shiyi to offer congratulations. In the second month the court visited Longhua Prefecture. On the jiayin new moon of the third month xiangwen Xiao Pide returned from Liaodong and reported that supreme commander Xiao Xiaomu had built fortresses five li from each side of the city to besiege it. Imperial son-in-law Yanning and his sister escaped through a tunnel; only Princess Cui Ba remained behind and was detected by the wall defenders and stopped. In the fourth summer month the court went to Qianling. Yelü Xingping was appointed Guangping Army military commissioner, Xia Xingmei Zhongshun Army military commissioner, Li Yanhong Yizhou intendant, and Xiao Congshun promoted to Crown Prince Grand Preceptor. On wushen day of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Baipo. On renwu day of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered civil service examinations the following year. On bingwu day of the eighth month Eastern Capital rebel general Yang Xiangshi secretly sent surrender, and at night opened the south gate to admit Liao troops. Yanlin was captured and Bohai was pacified. In the tenth winter month the court halted at Changning Marsh. On xinhai day of the eleventh month Nanjing regent Prince of Yan Xiao Xiaomu returned victorious with the eastern expedition troops and appeared before the Emperor in martial dress; the Emperor greatly feasted and rewarded him. The next day Xiao Xiaomu was made King of Dongping and Eastern Capital regent; imperial maternal uncle xiangwen and imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Pide was enfeoffed as King of Lanling; and Xi king Punu was promoted to Vice Director. Acting Yanjing regent and Vice Director Xiao Hui was appointed Yanjing supreme commander; the former supreme commander was made great general and military commissioner; Grand Chancellor and concurrent Privy Council commissioner Ma Baozhong was appointed acting Yanjing regent; and Xi Princes' Household metropolitan garrison commander Xiao Aguzhen was made Eastern Capital supreme commander. An edict ordered that Bohai old clans with merit and ability be appointed to office, while the rest were distributed to Lai, Xi, Qian, Run, and other prefectures. On yisi day of the twelfth month Song sent Mei Xun and Wang Lingjie to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival. Qishui Commandery King Yelü Dilie was promoted to Esteemed Father; Wugu Department military commissioner Xiao Puda was made Yishi Department king; and Left Vice Minister of the Masters Xiao Lin was appointed Linhai Army military commissioner.
十一年春正月己酉朔，如混同江。二月，如長春河。三月，上不豫。夏五月，大雨水，諸河橫流，皆失故道。六月丁丑朔，駐蹕大福河之北。己卯，帝崩於行宮，年六十一，在位四十九年。景福元年閏十月壬申，上尊謚曰文武大孝宣皇帝，廟號聖宗。

In the eleventh year, on the jiyou new moon of the first spring month the court went to Huntong River. In the second month the court went to Changchun River. In the third month the Emperor fell ill. In the fifth summer month great rains fell; all rivers flowed across the land and lost their old channels. On the dingchou new moon of the sixth month the court halted north of the Dafu River. On jimao day the Emperor died at the mobile palace at age sixty-one, having reigned forty-nine years. In the first year of Jingfu, on renshen day of the intercalary tenth month, the posthumous title Wenwu Daxiao Xuan Emperor was elevated and the temple name Shengzong was granted.
贊曰：聖宗幼沖嗣位，政出慈闈。及宋人二道來攻，親禦甲胄，一舉而復燕、雲，破信、彬，再舉而躪河、朔，不亦偉歟！既而侈心一啟，佳兵不祥，東有茶、陀之敗，西有甘州之喪，此狃於常勝之過也。然其踐阼四十九年，理冤滯，舉才行，察貪殘，抑奢僭，錄死事之子孫，振諸部之貧乏，責迎合不忠之罪，卻高麗女樂之歸。遼之諸帝，在位長久，令名無窮，其唯聖宗乎！

The eulogy says: Shengzong succeeded while young, and government issued from the empress dowager. When Song forces attacked by two routes he personally donned armor; in one campaign he recovered Yan and Yun and defeated Xin and Bin, and in a second he trampled Hebei—is this not magnificent! Then when extravagant desire opened, fine armies proved ill-omened; in the east came the defeat at Cha and Tuo, in the west the loss at Ganzhou—this was the fault of trusting constant victory. Yet in his forty-nine years on the throne he cleared wrongs held over, promoted talent and conduct, scrutinized cruelty and greed, restrained extravagance and presumption, enrolled descendants of those who died in service, relieved poverty among the tribes, punished fawning disloyalty, and refused the return of Goryeo female musicians. Among Liao emperors who reigned long and whose good names are endless, was it not Shengzong alone!
018: 興宗一
Xingzong, Part One

十一年夏六月己卯，聖宗崩，即皇帝位於柩前。壬午，尊母元妃蕭氏為皇太后。甲申，遣使告哀於宋及夏、高麗。是年，禦宣政殿放進士劉貞等五十七人。辛卯，大赦，改元景福。乙未，奉大行皇帝梓宮，殯於永安山太平殿。辛丑，皇太后賜駙馬蕭鉏不裏、蕭匹敵死，圍場都太師女直著骨裏、右祗候郎君詳穩蕭延留等七人皆棄市，籍其家，遷齊天皇后於上京。秋七月丙午朔，皇太后率皇族大臨於太平殿。高麗遣使吊慰。上召晉王蕭普古等飲博，夜分乃罷。丁未，擊鞠。戊申，以耶律韓八為左夷離畢，特末裏為左祗候郎君詳穩，橫帳郎君樂古權右祗候郎君祥穩。己酉，以耶律鄭留為於厥迪烈都詳穩，高八為右皮室詳穩。庚戌，賑薊州民饑。癸丑，詔寫大行皇帝御容。甲寅，錄囚。以觀察姚居信為上將軍。建慶州於慶陵之南，徙民實之，充奉陵邑。乙卯，以比歲豐稔，罷給東京統軍司糧。丁巳，上謁大行皇帝御容，哀慟久之。因詔寫北府宰相蕭孝先、南府宰相蕭孝穆像於御容殿。以蕭阿姑軫為東京留守。丁卯，謁太平殿，焚先帝所禦弓矢。幸晉王普古第視疾。辛未，錄囚。壬申，上謁神主帳，時奧隈蕭氏始入宮，亦命拜之。八月壬午，遷大行皇帝梓宮於菆塗殿。九月戊申，躬視慶陵。庚戌，問安於皇太后。辛亥，宋遣王隨、曹儀致祭，王鬷、許懷信、梅詢、張綸來慰兩宮，範諷、孫繼業賀即位，孔道輔、魏昭文賀皇太吊後冊禮。戊午，焚弧矢、鞍勒於菆塗殿。庚申，夏國遣使來慰。庚午，以宋使吊祭，喪服臨菆塗殿。甲戌，遣御史中丞耶律翥、司農卿張確、詳穩耶律勵、四方館使高維翰謝宋吊慰。冬十月戊寅，宰臣呂德懋薨。癸未，殺鉏不裏黨彌勒奴、觀音奴等。丙戌，遣工部尚書高德順、崇祿卿李可封致先帝遺物於宋；以右領軍衛上將軍耶律遜、少府監馬憚充皇太后謝宋使；右監門衛上將軍耶律元載、引進使魏永充皇帝謝宋使。丁酉，夏國遣使來賻。戊戌，以蕭革、趙為果、耶律郁、馬保業充來歲賀宋正旦使副。閏月辛亥，謁菆塗殿，閱玄宮器。有司請以生辰為永壽節，皇太后生辰為應聖節，從之。辛酉，閱新造鎧甲。丁卯，振黃龍府饑民。十一月壬辰，上率百僚奠於菆塗殿。出大行皇帝服御、玩好焚之。縱五坊鷹鶻。甲午，葬文武大孝宣皇帝於慶陵。乙未，祭天地。問安皇太后。丙申，謁慶陵，以遺物賜群臣，名其山曰慶雲，殿曰望仙。十二月癸丑，至自慶陵。皇太后聽政，帝不親庶務，群臣表請，不從。是歲，以興平公主下嫁夏國王李德昭子元昊，以元昊為夏國公、駙馬都尉。

In the eleventh year, on jimao day of the sixth summer month Shengzong died, and [the heir] immediately took the throne before the coffin. On rennwu day the new Emperor honored his mother, Lady Xiao, as Empress Dowager. On jiashen day envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Song, Xia, and Goryeo. That year jinshi examinations were held at Xuanzheng Hall and fifty-seven candidates including Liu Zhen passed. On xinmao day a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Jingfu. On yiwei day the late Emperor's coffin was escorted and encoffined at Taiping Hall on Yong'an Mountain. On xinchou day the Empress Dowager ordered imperial son-in-law Xiao Cubu and Xiao Pide to death; Hunt-grounds grand preceptor Jurchen Zhuguli, Right Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen Xiao Yanliu, and seven others were all executed in the marketplace; their households were confiscated; and Empress Qi Tian was moved to the Upper Capital. On the bingwu new moon of the seventh autumn month the Empress Dowager led the imperial clan in great mourning at Taiping Hall. Goryeo dispatched envoys to express condolences. The Emperor summoned Prince of Jin Xiao Pugu and others to drink and gamble; only at midnight did they stop. On dingwei day the court played cuju. On wushen day Yelü Hanba was appointed Left yilibi; Temuli was made Left Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen; and Cross-Tent langjun Yegu acting Right Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen. On jiyou day Yelü Zhengliu was appointed Ugu diledu xiangwen and Gao Ba Right Pishi xiangwen. On gengxu day relief was provided for hungry people in Jizhou. On guichou day an edict ordered the late Emperor's portrait painted. On jiayin day prisoners were reviewed. Observation commissioner Yao Juxin was appointed upper general. Qingzhou was built south of Qing Mausoleum; people were moved to fill it, serving as a mausoleum-attendant settlement. On yimao day, because grain harvests had been abundant in recent years, grain supplies to the Eastern Capital military governor's office were discontinued. On dingsi day the Emperor visited the late Emperor's portrait and mourned deeply for a long time. Thereupon an edict ordered portraits of Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaoxian and Southern Chancellor Xiao Xiaomu painted in the Imperial Portrait Hall. Xiao Aguzhen was appointed Eastern Capital regent. On dingmao day the court visited Taiping Hall and burned the late Emperor's bow and arrows. The court visited Prince of Jin Pugu's residence to inquire after his illness. On xinwei day prisoners were reviewed. On renshen day the Emperor visited the spirit tablet tent; at that time aowei Lady Xiao had just entered the palace, and he was also ordered to bow to her. In the eighth month, on renwu day, the late Emperor's coffin was moved to Zutu Hall. In the ninth month, on wushen day, the Emperor personally inspected Qing Mausoleum. On gengxu day the Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager. On xinhai day Song sent Wang Sui and Cao Yi to perform sacrifices; Wang Ji, Xu Huaixin, Mei Xun, and Zhang Lun came to console the two palaces; Fan Feng and Sun Jiye congratulated on the accession; and Kong Daofu and Wei Zhaowen congratulated on the Empress Dowager's post-mourning investiture rites. On wuwu day bows, arrows, saddle, and bridle were burned at Zutu Hall. On gengshen day Xia State sent envoys with condolences. On gengwu day, because Song envoys came to mourn and sacrifice, the Emperor wore mourning dress and attended at Zutu Hall. On jiaxu day Censorate Vice Director Yelü Xu, Minister of Agriculture Zhang Que, xiangwen Yelü Li, and Four Directions Bureau envoy Gao Weihan were dispatched to thank Song for condolences. On wuyin day of the tenth winter month chief minister Lü Demao died. On guiwei day Cubu faction members Mile Nu, Guanyin Nu, and others were executed. On bingxu day Minister of Works Gao Deshun and Chamberlain for Imperial Insignia Li Kefeng were dispatched to present the late Emperor's bequests to Song; Right Imperial Guard upper general Yelü Xun and Palace Manufactories supervisor Ma Dan were appointed envoys to thank Song on behalf of the Empress Dowager; Right Palace Gate Guard upper general Yelü Yuanzai and presenting envoy Wei Yong served as the Emperor's envoys to thank Song. On dingyou day Xia State sent envoys with funeral gifts. On wuxu day Xiao Ge, Zhao Weiguo, Yelü Yu, and Ma Baoye were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year. In the intercalary month, on xinhai day, the court visited Zutu Hall and inspected inner-chamber vessels. The relevant offices requested making the Emperor's birthday the Eternal Longevity Festival and the Empress Dowager's birthday the Responding Sage Festival; approval was granted. On xinyou day newly made armor was inspected. On dingmao day hungry people in Huanglong Prefecture were relieved. On renchen day of the eleventh month the Emperor led all officials in offerings at Zutu Hall. The late Emperor's clothing, accoutrements, and treasured articles were brought out and burned. The five-compound hawks and falcons were released. On jiawu day the Cultured and Martial Great Filial Xuan Emperor was buried at Qing Mausoleum. On yiwei day sacrifices were offered to Heaven and Earth. The Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager. On bingshen day the court visited Qing Mausoleum, bestowed bequest articles on ministers, named the mountain Qingyun, and named the hall Wangxian. On guichou day of the twelfth month the court returned from Qing Mausoleum. The Empress Dowager held court; the Emperor did not personally handle routine affairs; ministers memorialized requesting that he do so, but he did not agree. That year Princess Xingping was married to Li Dezhao's son Yuanhao of Xia State; Yuanhao was made Duke of Xia State and Commandant of Imperial Son-in-law.

重熙元年春正月壬申朔，皇太后禦正殿，受帝與群臣朝。宋遣任布、王遵範、陳琰、王克善來賀。乙亥，宋遣鄭向、郭遵範來賀永壽節。丁丑，如雪林。二月，大蒐。三月壬申朔，尚父、漆水郡王敵烈復為惕隱。是春，皇太后誣齊天皇后以罪，遣人即上京行弒。後請具浴以就死，許之。有頃，後崩。夏四月乙巳，清暑別輦鬥。秋七月，獵平地松林。以蕭達溥、王英秀、蕭麓、張素羽充來歲賀宋正旦生辰使。八月丙午，駐蹕剌河源。皇子洪基生。冬十月己酉，幸中京。十一月己卯，帝率群臣上皇太后尊號曰法天應運仁德章聖皇太后；群臣上皇帝尊號曰文武仁聖昭孝皇帝。大赦，改元重熙。癸未，宋遣劉隨、王德本來賀應聖節。以楊佶為翰林承旨。丙戌，夏國遣使來賀。辛卯，五國酋長來貢。夏國王李德昭薨，冊其子夏國公元昊為夏國王。十二月庚戌，宋遣胥偃、王從益、崔暨、張懷誌來賀來歲正旦；又遣楊日嚴、王克纂來賀永壽節。以北大王耶律求翰同平章事。是年，放進士劉師貞等五十七人。

In the first year of Chongqing, on the renshen new moon of the first spring month the Empress Dowager held court at the main hall and received obeisance from the Emperor and ministers. Song sent Ren Bu, Wang Zunfan, Chen Yan, and Wang Keshan with congratulations. On yihai day Song sent Zheng Xiang and Guo Zunfan to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival. On dingchou day the court went to Xuelin. In the second month a grand hunt was held. On the renshen new moon of the third month Imperial Father, Prince of Qishui Dilie, was again appointed tiyin. That spring the Empress Dowager falsely charged Empress Qi Tian with crimes and dispatched people to assassinate her at the Upper Capital. The Empress requested a full bath before death; permission was granted. Before long the Empress died. On yisi day of the fourth summer month the court took the summer retreat at Bielian Dou. In the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest. Xiao Dapu, Wang Yingxiu, Xiao Lu, and Zhang Suyu were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day and birthdays of the coming year. In the eighth month, on bingwu day, the court encamped at Cila River source. The imperial prince Hongji was born. On jiyou day of the tenth winter month the court visited the Central Capital. On jimao day of the eleventh month the Emperor led ministers in presenting to the Empress Dowager the honorific title Responding to Heaven, Following the Mandate, Benevolent and Virtuous, Manifest Sage Empress Dowager; ministers presented to the Emperor the honorific title Cultured and Martial, Benevolent and Sage, Illustrious and Filial Emperor. A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Chongqing. On guiwei day Song sent Liu Sui and Wang Deben to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival. Yang Jie was appointed Hanlin Academician Recipient. On bingxu day Xia State sent envoys to congratulate. On xinmao day chiefs of the Five States came with tribute. King Li Dezhao of Xia State died; his son Duke of Xia State Yuanhao was enfeoffed as King of Xia State. On gengxu day of the twelfth month Song sent Xu Yan, Wang Congyi, Cui Ji, and Zhang Huaizhi to congratulate New Year's Day of the coming year; Song also sent Yang Riyan and Wang Kezuan to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival. Northern Great King Yelü Qiuhantong was appointed Associate Councilor of State. That year jinshi examinations were held and Liu Shizhen and fifty-six others passed.

二年春正月庚辰，東幸。乙酉，夏國遣使來貢。壬辰，女直詳穩臺押率所部來貢。宋遣曹琮來告母後劉氏哀，章得象、安繼昌來饋母後遺物。即遣興聖宮使耶律壽寧、給事中知制誥李奎充祭奠使；天德軍節度使耶律卿寧、大理卿和道亨、河西軍節度使耶律嵩、引進使馬世卿充兩宮吊慰。秋七月甲子朔，以耶律寔、高升、耶律迪、王惟允充兩宮賀宋生辰使副，以耶律師古、劉五常充賀宋來歲正旦使副。八月丁酉，幸溫泉宮。乙卯，遣使閱諸路禾稼。冬十一月甲申，宋遣劉寶、符忠、李昭述、張茂實等來謝慰奠。十二月乙未，宋遣丁度、王繼凝來賀應聖節。乙酉，禁夏國使沿路私市金、鐵。甲寅，宋遣章頻、李懿、王沖睦、張緯、李纮、李繼一來賀永壽節及來歲正旦。庚申，以北府宰相蕭孝先為樞密使。

In the second year, on gengchen day of the first spring month the court made an eastern tour. On yiyou day Xia State sent envoys with tribute. On renchen day Jurchen xiangwen Taiyashuai came with his followers to pay tribute. Song sent Cao Cong to announce mourning for Empress Dowager Liu, and Zhang Dexiang and An Jichang came bearing her bequests. Xingsheng Palace envoy Yelü Shouning and Supervising Censor drafting edicts Li Kui were immediately dispatched as sacrificial envoys; Tiande Army military commissioner Yelü Qingning, Court of Judicial Review director He Daoheng, Hexi Army military commissioner Yelü Song, and presenting envoy Ma Shiqing served as envoys to console the two palaces. On the jiazi new moon of the seventh autumn month Yelü Shi, Gao Sheng, Yelü Di, and Wang Weiyun were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the two Song palaces on birthdays, and Yelü Shigu and Liu Wuchang chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year. In the eighth month, on dingyou day, the court visited Hot Springs Palace. On yimao day envoys were dispatched to inspect grain crops on all routes. On jiashen day of the eleventh winter month Song sent Liu Bao, Fu Zhong, Li Zhaoshu, Zhang Maoshi, and others to thank for consolation and offerings. On yiwei day of the twelfth month Song sent Ding Du and Wang Jining to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival. On yiyou day Xia State envoys were forbidden to privately trade gold and iron along the route. On jiayin day Song sent Zhang Pin, Li Yi, Wang Chongmu, Zhang Wei, Li Hong, and Li Jiyi to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival and New Year's Day of the coming year. On gengshen day Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaoxian was appointed Privy Commissioner.

三年春正月丁卯，宋使章頻卒，詔有司賻贈，命近侍護喪以歸。辛卯，如春水。二月壬辰朔，以北院樞密使蕭普古為東京留守。戊申，耶律大師奴有侍繈褓恩，詔入屬籍。夏四月甲寅，振耶迷只部。五月庚申朔，清暑沿柳湖。是月，皇太后還政於上，躬守慶陵。六月己亥，以蕭普古為南院樞密使。秋七月戊子朔，上始親政，以耶律庶徵、劉六符、耶律睦、薄可久充賀宋來歲正旦使副。壬辰，如秋山。冬十月已未，駐蹕中會川。十二月，宋遣段少連、杜仁贊來賀來歲正旦，楊偕、李守忠來賀永壽節。

In the third year, on dingmao day of the first spring month Song envoy Zhang Pin died; an edict ordered the relevant offices to grant funeral gifts and commanded close attendants to escort the coffin home. On xinmao day the court went to spring waters. On the renchen new moon of the second month Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Pugu was appointed Eastern Capital regent. On wushen day Yelü Dashinu had cradle attendant grace; an edict ordered him entered into the clan registry. In the fourth summer month, on jiayin day, relief was provided for the Yemizhi tribe. On the gengshen new moon of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat along Yangliu Lake. That month the Empress Dowager returned government to the Emperor and personally guarded Qing Mausoleum. On jihai day of the sixth month Xiao Pugu was appointed Southern Court Privy Commissioner. On the wuzi new moon of the seventh autumn month the Emperor began to personally administer government; Yelü Shuzheng, Liu Liufu, Yelü Mu, and Bo Kejiu were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year. On renchen day the court went to Autumn Mountain. On jiwei day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Zhonghui River. In the twelfth month Song sent Duan Shaolian and Du Renzan to congratulate New Year's Day of the coming year, and Yang Xie and Li Shouzhong to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.

四年春正月庚寅，如耶迷只裏。三月乙酉朔，立皇后蕭氏。夏四月甲寅朔，如涼陘。五月庚子，清暑散水源。六月癸丑朔，皇子寶信奴生。以耶律信、呂士宗、蕭袞、郭揆充賀宋生辰及來歲正旦使副。秋七月壬午朔，獵於黑嶺。九月乙酉，駐蹕長寧澱。冬十月，如王子城。十一月壬午，改南京總管府為元帥府。乙酉，行柴冊禮於白嶺，大赦。加尚父耶律信寧、政事令耶律求翰耆宿贊翊功臣。十二月癸丑，詔諸軍炮、弩、弓、劍手以時閱習。庚申，宋遣鄭戩、柴貽範、楊日華、張士禹來賀永壽節及正旦。

In the fourth year, on gengyin day of the first spring month, the court went to Yemizhi territory. On the yiyou new moon of the third month Empress Xiao was installed. On the jiayin new moon of the fourth summer month the court went to Cool Pass. On gengzi day of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Sanshui source. On the guichou new moon of the sixth month the imperial prince Baoxinnu was born. Yelü Xin, Lü Shizong, Xiao Gun, and Guo Kui were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays and New Year's Day of the coming year. On the renwu new moon of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Black Ridge. On yiyou day of the ninth month the court halted at Changning Marsh. In the tenth winter month the court went to Prince City. On renwu day of the eleventh month Nanjing supreme commander office was renamed marshal's headquarters. On yiyou day the firewood-and-script rites were performed at White Ridge and a general amnesty was proclaimed. Esteemed Father Yelü Xinning and Political Affairs Commissioner Yelü Qiuhan were granted the title Elder Minister Assisting Accomplished Merit. On guichou day of the twelfth month an edict ordered artillery, crossbow, bow, and sword troops of all armies to drill on schedule. On gengshen day Song sent Zheng Jian, Chai Yifan, Yang Rihua, and Zhang Shiyu to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival and New Year's Day.

五年春正月甲申，如魚兒濼。樞密使蕭延寧請改國舅乙室小功帳敞史為將軍，從之。夏四月庚申，以潞王查葛為南府宰相，崇德宮使耶律馬六為惕隱。甲子，幸後弟蕭無曲第，曲水泛觴賦詩。丁卯，頒新定條制。己巳，上與大臣分朋擊鞠。五月甲午，南幸。丁未，如胡土白山清暑。庚申，幸北院大王高十行帳拜奧，賜銀絹。壬戌，詔修南京宮闕府署。秋七月辛丑，錄囚。耶律把八誣其弟韓哥謀殺己，有司奏當反坐。臨刑，其弟泣訴：「臣惟一兄，乞貸其死。」上憫而從之。九月癸巳，獵黃花山，獲熊三十六，賞獵人有差。冬十月丁未，幸南京。辛亥，曲赦析津府境內囚。壬子，禦元和殿，以《日射三十六熊賦》、《幸燕詩》試進士於廷，賜馮立、趙徽四十九人進士第。以馮立為右補闕，趙徽以下皆為太子中舍，賜緋衣、銀魚，遂大宴。禦試進士自此始。宋遣宋郊、王世文來賀永壽節。甲子，宰臣張儉等請幸禮部貢院，歡飲至暮而罷，賜物有差。以耶律祥、張素民、耶律甫、王澤充賀宋生辰正旦使副。

In the fifth year, on jiashen day of the first spring month, the court went to Yu'er Marsh. Privy Commissioner Xiao Yanning requested that maternal uncle Yi Chamber Lesser Merit Tent Chang Shi be made a general; approval was granted. On gengshen day of the fourth summer month Prince of Lu Zhage was appointed Southern Chancellor and Chongde Palace commissioner Yelü Maliu tiyin. On jiazi day the court visited younger imperial brother-in-law Xiao Wuqu's residence, floated wine cups on winding water, and composed poetry. On dingmao day newly fixed regulations were promulgated. On jisi day the Emperor and ministers divided into teams and played cuju. On jiawu day of the fifth month the court made a southern tour. On dingwei day the court went to Hutu White Mountain for the summer retreat. On gengshen day the court visited Northern Court great king Gao Shi's mobile tent and paid respects at the ancestral tent, bestowing silver and silk. On renxu day an edict ordered repair of Nanjing palace gates and government offices. On xinchou day of the seventh autumn month prisoners were reviewed. Yelü Baba falsely accused his younger brother Hange of plotting to kill him; the relevant offices memorialized that counter-penalty applied. At execution his younger brother wept and pleaded: "Your subject has only one elder brother; I beg his life be spared. " The Emperor took pity and granted the request. On guisi day of the ninth month the court hunted at Yellow Flower Mountain, captured thirty-six bears, and rewarded the hunters in differing amounts. On dingwei day of the tenth winter month the court visited Nanjing. On xinhai day a partial amnesty was granted to prisoners within Qijin Prefecture. On renzi day the Emperor attended Yuanhe Hall, tested jinshi at court with "Essay on Shooting Thirty-six Bears in a Day" and "Poem on the Journey to Yan," and granted jinshi rank to forty-nine including Feng Li and Zhao Hui. Feng Li was appointed Right Remonstrance Censor; Zhao Hui and below were all made Crown Prince Middle Attendants; crimson robes and silver fish tally were bestowed, and then a great feast was held. Court examination of jinshi began from this point. Song sent Song Jiao and Wang Shiwen to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival. On jiazi day chief minister Zhang Jian and others requested visiting the Ministry of Rites examination yard; they feasted until evening then stopped, and goods were bestowed in differing amounts. Yelü Xiang, Zhang Sumin, Yelü Fu, and Wang Ze were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays and New Year's Day.

六年春正月丁丑，西幸。三月戊寅，以秦王蕭孝穆為北院樞密使，徙封吳王；晉王蕭孝先為南京留守。夏四月，獵野狐嶺。閏月，獵龍門縣西山。五月己酉，清暑炭山。以耶律韓八為北院大王，蕭把哥左夷離畢，王子郎君詳穩鼻姑得林牙，簽北面事耶律涅哥同簽點檢司。甲寅，錄囚。以南大王耶律信寧故匿重囚及侍婢贓汙，命撻以劍脊而奪其官；都監坐阿附及侍婢罪，皆論死，詔貸之。丙辰，以耶律信寧為西南路招討使。庚申，出飛龍廄馬，賜皇太弟重元及北、南面侍臣有差。癸亥，以上京留守耶律胡睹袞為南大王，平章事蕭查剌寧上京留守，侍中管寧行宮都部署，耶律蒲奴寧烏古迪烈得都詳穩。甲子，以上京留守耶律洪古為北院大王。六月壬申朔，以善寧為殿前都點檢，護衛太保耶律合住兼長寧宮使，蕭阿剌裏、耶律烏魯斡、耶律和尚、蕭韓家奴、蕭特裏、蕭求翰為各宮都部署。上酒酣賦詩，吳國王蕭孝穆、北宰相蕭撒八等皆屬和，夜中乃罷。己卯，祀天地。癸未，賜南院大王耶律胡睹袞命，上親為制誥詞，並賜詩以寵之。丙申，以北院大王侯哂為南京統軍使。秋七月辛丑朔，以北、南樞密院獄空，賞賚有差。壬寅，以皇太弟重元生子，賜詩及寶玩器物，曲赦死罪以下。癸卯，如秋山。八月己卯，北樞密院言越棘部民苦其酋帥坤長不法，多流亡；詔罷越棘等五國酋帥，以契丹節度使一員領之。冬十月癸酉，駐蹕石寶岡。十一月己亥朔，阻卜酋長來貢。辛亥，以契丹行宮都部署蕭惠為南院樞密使。壬子，以管寧為南院樞密使，蕭掃古諸行宮都部署，耶律裏知南面行宮副部署，蕭阿剌裏左祗候郎君詳穩，耶律曷主右祗候郎君詳穩。庚申，幸晉國公主行帳視疾。封皇子洪基為梁王。十二月，以楊佶為忠順軍節度使。遣耶律斡、秦鑒、耶律德、崔繼芳賀宋生辰及正旦。

In the sixth year, on dingchou day of the first spring month, the court made a western tour. On wuyin day of the third month Prince of Qin Xiao Xiaomu was appointed Northern Court Privy Commissioner and transferred in enfeoffment to King of Wu; Prince of Jin Xiao Xiaoxian was appointed Nanjing regent. In the fourth summer month the court hunted at Wild Fox Ridge. In the intercalary month the court hunted on the western mountains of Longmen county. On jiyou day of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Coal Mountain. Yelü Hanba was appointed Northern Court great king; Xiao Bage was made Left yilibi; prince langjun xiangwen Bi Gude linya; and Northern Affairs signatory Yelü Niege jointly signatory of the Inspectorate. On jiayin day prisoners were reviewed. Because Southern Great King Yelü Xinning had formerly concealed serious criminals and handmaidens involved in corruption, he was ordered beaten with the flat of a sword and stripped of office; the intendant and handmaidens, convicted of complicity, were all sentenced to death; an edict pardoned them. On bingchen day Yelü Xinning was appointed Southwestern Route pacification commissioner. On gengshen day Flying Dragon stable horses were brought out and bestowed on Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan and Northern and Southern attendants in differing amounts. On guihai day Upper Capital regent Yelü Huchuo was appointed Southern Great King; Associate Councilor Xiao Zhala Upper Capital regent; Palace Attendant Guan Ning mobile palace deployment director; and Yelü Punu Ningwu Ugu diledu xiangwen. On jiazi day Upper Capital regent Yelü Honggu was appointed Northern Court great king. On the renshen new moon of the sixth month Shanning was appointed Palace Front Command inspector; Guard Protector Grand Steward Yelü Hezhu concurrent Changning Palace commissioner; and Xiao Alali, Yelü Wuluwo, Yelü Heshang, Xiao Hanjianu, Xiao Teli, and Xiao Qiuhande deployment directors of their respective palaces. The Emperor, tipsy with wine, composed poetry; King of Wu Xiao Xiaomu, Northern Chancellor Xiao Saba, and others all joined in with matching verses; only at midnight did they stop. On jimao day sacrifices were offered to Heaven and Earth. On guiwei day commission was bestowed on Southern Court great king Yelü Huchuo; the Emperor personally drafted the appointment edict wording and also bestowed poetry to honor him. On bingshen day Northern Court great king Hou Shen was appointed Nanjing military governor. On the xinchou new moon of the seventh autumn month, because Northern and Southern Privy Council prisons were empty, rewards were granted in differing amounts. On renyin day, because Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan had a son born, poetry and precious curios were bestowed and a partial amnesty was granted below capital crimes. On guimao day the court went to Autumn Mountain. On jimao day of the eighth month the Northern Privy Council reported that Yueji tribe people suffered under their chieftain Kunzhang's lawlessness and many had fled; an edict abolished the chieftains of Yueji and the other Five States and placed them under a single Khitan military commissioner. On guiyou day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Shibao Ridge. On the jihai new moon of the eleventh month Zubu chieftains came with tribute. On xinhai day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Xiao Hui was appointed Southern Court Privy Commissioner. On renzi day Guan Ning was appointed Southern Court Privy Commissioner; Xiao Saogu deployment director of all mobile palaces; Yelü Lizhi Southern mobile palace deputy deployment director; Xiao Alali Left Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen; and Yelü Hezhu Right Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen. On gengshen day the court visited Jin State Princess's mobile tent to inquire after her illness. Imperial prince Hongji was enfeoffed as King of Liang. In the twelfth month Yang Jie was appointed Zhongshun Army military commissioner. Yelü Wo, Qin Jian, Yelü De, and Cui Jifang were dispatched to congratulate Song on birthdays and New Year's Day.

七年春正月戊戌朔，宋遣高若訥、夏元正、謝絳、張茂實來賀正旦及永壽節。辛丑，如混同江。二月庚午，如春州。乙亥，駐蹕東川。丁丑，高麗遣使來貢。壬午，幸五坊閱鷹鶻。乙酉，遣使慶州問安皇太后。三月戊戌朔，幸皇太弟重元行帳。壬寅，如蒲河澱。辛亥，夏國遣使來貢。甲寅，錄囚。夏四月己巳，以興平公主薨，遣北院承旨耶律庶成持詔問夏國王李元昊，公主生與元昊不睦，沒，詰其故。己卯，獵白馬堝。甲申，射兔新澱井。乙未，獵金山，遣楊家進鹿尾茸於大安宮。六月乙亥，禦清涼殿試進士，賜邢彭年以下五十五人第。秋七月甲辰，錄囚。乙巳，阻卜酋長屯禿古斯來朝。戊申，如黑嶺。九月丁未，駐蹕平澱。冬十月甲子朔，渡遼河。丙寅，駐蹕白馬澱。壬申，錄囚。十一月癸巳朔，以耶律元方、張泥、韓至德、蕭傅充賀宋生辰正旦使副。辛丑，問安皇太后，進珍玩。庚申，錄囚。十二月，召善擊鞠者數十人於東京，令與近臣角勝，上臨觀之。己巳，以皇太弟重元判北南院樞密使事，北府宰相撒八寧再任兼知東京留守事，耶律應穩南府宰相，查割折大內惕隱，乙室已帳蕭翰乾州節度使，劉六符參知政事，王子帳冠哥王子郎君詳穩，鉏窘大王平州節度使，宰臣張克恭守司空，宰臣韓紹芳加侍中，惕隱耶律馬六北院宣徽使，傅父耶律喜孫南府宰相。癸未，宋遣王舉正、張士禹來賀永壽節。甲申，命日進酒於大安宮，致薦慶陵。丁亥，錄囚，非故殺者減科。南面侍御壯骨裏詐取女直貢物，罪死，上以有吏能，黥而流之。

In the seventh year, on the wuxu new moon of the first spring month, Song sent Gao Ruone, Xia Yuanzheng, Xie Jiang, and Zhang Maoshi to congratulate New Year's Day and the Eternal Longevity Festival. On xinchou day the court went to Huntong River. On gengwu day of the second month the court went to Chunzhou. On yihai day the court halted at East River. On dingchou day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute. On renwu day the court visited the Five Compounds to inspect hawks and falcons. On yiyou day envoys were dispatched to Qingzhou to inquire after the Empress Dowager's health. On the wuxu new moon of the third month the court visited Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan's mobile tent. On renyin day the court went to Puhe Marsh. On xinhai day Xia State sent envoys with tribute. On jiayin day prisoners were reviewed. On jisi day of the fourth summer month, because Princess Xingping had died, Northern Court recipient Yelü Shucheng was dispatched with an edict to question Xia King Li Yuanhao, as the Princess had been at odds with Yuanhao in life and the reason was to be demanded upon her death. On jimao day the court hunted at White Horse Bend. On jiashen day the court shot rabbits at Xindian Marsh. On yiwei day the court hunted at Jin Mountain and dispatched the Yang family to present deer-tail velvet to Da'an Palace. On yihai day of the sixth month the Emperor attended the Cool Hall, tested jinshi, and granted rank to fifty-five including Xing Pengnian and below. On jiachen day of the seventh autumn month prisoners were reviewed. On yisi day Zubu chieftain Tuntugusi came to court. On wushen day the court went to Black Ridge. On dingwei day of the ninth month the court halted at Ping Marsh. On the jiazi new moon of the tenth winter month the court crossed the Liao River. On bingyin day the court halted at White Horse Marsh. On renshen day prisoners were reviewed. On the guisi new moon of the eleventh month Yelü Yuanfang, Zhang Ni, Han Zhide, and Xiao Fu were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays and New Year's Day. On xinchou day the Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager and presented precious curios. On gengshen day prisoners were reviewed. In the twelfth month several dozen skilled cuju players were summoned to the Eastern Capital to compete against close ministers while the Emperor watched. On jisi day Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan was appointed to oversee Northern and Southern Privy Council affairs; Northern Chancellor Saba Ning was reappointed and concurrently Eastern Capital regent; Yelü Yingwen was made Southern Court chancellor; Zhagezhe Great Inner tiyin; Yishi Account Xiao Han Qianzhou military commissioner; Liu Liufu Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner; Princes' Household Guange princes' household langjun xiangwen; King Chujiong Pingzhou military commissioner; Grand Chancellor Zhang Ke'gong concurrent Minister of Works; Grand Chancellor Han Shaofang was promoted to Palace Attendant; tiyin Yelü Maliu Northern Court xuanhui commissioner; and foster father Yelü Xisun Southern Court chancellor. On guiwei day Song sent Wang Juzheng and Zhang Shiyu to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival. On jiashen day the court ordered daily wine offerings at Great Tranquility Palace in devotion at Qing Mausoleum. On dinghai day prisoners were reviewed, and penalties were reduced for those not guilty of deliberate murder. Southern attendant Zhuangguli fraudulently seized Jurchen tribute goods, a capital offense; because the Emperor valued his administrative ability, he was tattooed and banished instead.

八年春正月壬辰朔，宋遣韓琦、王從益來賀。丙申，如混同江觀漁。戊戌，振品部。庚戌，叉魚於率沒裏河。丁巳，禁朔州鬻羊於宋。二月丙子，駐蹕長春河。夏六月乙丑，詔括戶口。秋七月丁巳，謁慶陵，致奠於望仙殿。迎皇太后至顯州，謁園陵，還京。冬十月，駐蹕東京。十一月甲午，詔有言北院處事失平，擊鐘及邀駕告者，悉以奏聞。戊戌，朝皇太后，召僧論佛法。戊申，皇太后行再生禮，大赦。己酉，城長春。閏十二月壬辰，視吳國王蕭孝穆疾。宋遣龐籍、杜贊來賀永壽節。

In the eighth year, on the renchen new moon of the first spring month, Song sent Han Qi and Wang Congyi to offer congratulations. On bingshen day the court went to Huntong River to watch the fishing. On wuxu day relief was granted to the Pin tribe. On gengxu day the court went ice fishing on the Shuaimoli River. On dingsi day the sale of sheep from Shuozhou to Song was prohibited. On bingzi day of the second month the court encamped at Changchun River. On yichou day of the sixth summer month an edict ordered a household registration survey. On dingsi day of the seventh autumn month the court visited Qing Mausoleum and offered sacrifice at Wangxian Hall. The Empress Dowager was escorted to Xianzhou, the garden mausoleum was visited, and the court returned to the capital. In the tenth winter month the court encamped at the Eastern Capital. On jiawu day of the eleventh month an edict ordered that anyone reporting unfair handling by the Northern Court, whether by striking the bell or intercepting the imperial procession, must have the matter submitted to the throne. On wuxu day the Emperor attended the Empress Dowager at court and summoned monks to discuss Buddhist teaching. On wushen day the Empress Dowager performed the regeneration rite and a general amnesty was proclaimed. On jiyou day Changchun was fortified. On renchen day of the intercalary twelfth month the Emperor visited King of Wu Xiao Xiaomu, who was ill. Song sent Pang Ji and Du Zan to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.

九年春正月丙辰朔，上進酒於皇太后宮，禦正殿。宋遣王拱辰、彭再思來賀。庚申，如鴨子河。二月，駐蹕魚兒濼。三月辛未，以應聖節，大赦。五月乙卯朔，清暑永安山。六月，射柳祈雨。秋七月癸酉，宋遣郭禎以伐夏來報，遣樞密使杜防報聘。丁丑，如秋山。冬十月癸未朔，駐蹕中會川。十一月甲子，女直侵邊，髮黃龍府鐵驪軍拒之。宋遣蘇伸、向傳範來賀應聖節。十二月庚寅，以北大王府布猥帳郎君自言先世與國聯姻，許置敞史，命本帳蕭胡睹為之。辛卯，以所得女直戶置肅州。以蕭迪、劉三嘏、耶律元方、王惟吉、耶律庶忠、孫文昭、蕭紹筠、秦德昌充賀宋生辰及來歲正旦使副。詔諸犯法者，不得為官吏，諸職官非婚祭，不得沈酗廢事。有治民安邊之略者，悉具以聞。

In the ninth year, on the bingchen new moon of the first spring month, the Emperor offered wine at the Empress Dowager's palace and held court in the main hall. Song sent Wang Gongchen and Peng Zaisi to offer congratulations. On gengshen day the court went to Yazi River. In the second month the court encamped at Yu'er Marsh. On xinwei day of the third month a general amnesty was proclaimed for the Responding Sage Festival. On the yimao new moon of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain. In the sixth month the court performed the willow-shooting rite to pray for rain. On guiyou day of the seventh autumn month Song sent Guo Zhen to report its campaign against Western Xia; Privy Council commissioner Du Fang was dispatched on a return mission. On dingchou day the court went to Autumn Mountain. On the guiwei new moon of the tenth winter month the court encamped at Zhonghuichuan. On jiazi day of the eleventh month Jurchen raided the border, and the Tieli Army of Huanglong Prefecture was mobilized to repel them. Song sent Su Shen and Xiang Chuanfan to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival. On gengyin day of the twelfth month, because a langjun of the Northern Great King Household's Buwei Account claimed ancestral marriage ties with the dynasty, permission was granted to establish a chanshi, and Xiao Hudu of that account was appointed to the post. On xinmao day Suzhou was established with the Jurchen households that had been obtained. Xiao Di, Liu Sangui, Yelü Yuanfang, Wang Weiji, Yelü Shuzhong, Sun Wenzhao, Xiao Shaojun, and Qin Dechang were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays and on New Year's Day of the coming year. An edict declared that convicted offenders may not hold office and that officials may not become drunk and neglect their duties except at weddings and sacrifices. Those with plans for governing the people and securing the borders were ordered to submit full reports.
019: 十年春正月辛亥朔，宋遣梁適、張從一、富弼、趙日宣來賀。甲子，復遣吳育、馮戴來賀永壽節。二月庚辰朔，詔蒲盧毛朵部歸曷蘇館戶之沒入者使復業。甲申，北樞密院言，南、北二王府及諸部節度侍衛祗候郎君，皆出族帳，既免與民戍邊，其祗候事，請亦得以部曲代行。詔從其請。夏四月，詔罷修鴨淥江浮梁及漢兵屯戍之役。又以東京留守蕭撒八言，馳東京擊鞠之禁。六月戊寅朔，以蕭寧、耶律坦、崔禹稱、馬世良、耶律仁先、劉六符充賀宋生辰使副；耶律庶成、趙成、耶律烈、張旦充來歲賀宋正旦使副。秋七月壬戌，詔諸職官私取官物者，以正盜論。諸敢以先朝已斷事相告言者，罪之。諸帳郎君等於禁地射鹿，決三百，不征償；小將軍決二百以下；及百姓犯者，罪同郎君論。八月丙戌，以醫者鄧延貞治詳穩蕭留寧疾驗，贈其父母官以獎之。九月辛亥，朝皇太后。國舅留寧薨。庚申，皇太后射獲熊，上進酒為壽。癸亥，上獵馬孟山，草木蒙密，恐獵者誤射傷人，命耶律迪姑各書姓名於矢以誌之。丙寅，夏國獻宋俘。以石硬砦太保郭三避虎不射，免官。冬十月丙戌，詔東京留守蕭孝忠察官吏有廉幹清強者，具以名聞。庚寅，以女直太師臺押為曷蘇館都大王。辛卯，以皇子胡盧斡裏生，北宰相、駙馬撒八寧迎上至其第宴飲，上命衛士與漢人角觝為樂。壬辰，復飲皇太后殿，以皇子生，肆赦。夕，復引公主、駙馬及內族大臣入寢殿劇飲。甲午，幸中京。庚子，以駙馬都尉蕭忽列為國舅詳穩。十一月丙辰，回鶻遣使來貢。十二月丙子朔，宋遣劉沆、王整來賀應聖節。乙未，置撻朮不姑酋長。以胡撻剌為平章事。上聞宋設關河，治壕塹，恐為邊患，與南、北樞密吳國王蕭孝穆、趙國王蕭貫寧謀取宋舊割關南十縣地，遂遣蕭英、劉六符使宋。庚寅，宋遣張沔、侯宗亮、薛申、侍其浚、施昌言、潘永照來賀永壽節及來歲正旦。以宣政殿學士楊佶為吏部尚書、判順義軍節度使事。丁酉，議伐宋，詔諭諸道。

In the tenth year, on the xinhai new moon of the first spring month Song sent Liang Shi, Zhang Congyi, Fu Bi, and Zhao Rixuan with congratulations. On jiazi day Wu Yu and Feng Dai were again dispatched to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival. On the gengchen new moon of the second month an edict ordered households of the Pulu Modu tribe who had returned to Yasus Guan and been confiscated to resume their occupations. On jiashen day the Northern Privy Council reported that attendants of the Southern and Northern Princes' palaces and various tribal military commissioners all came from tribal tents; since they were exempted from border garrison service along with commoners, it requested that attendant duties also be permitted to be performed by retainers in their stead. An edict approved the request. In the fourth summer month an edict abolished the work of building the Yalü River pontoon bridge and Han troops' border garrison service. Also, because Eastern Capital regent Xiao Saba memorialized, the ban on cuju in the Eastern Capital was lifted. On the wuyin new moon of the sixth month Xiao Ning, Yelü Tan, Cui Yucheng, Ma Shiliang, Yelü Renxian, and Liu Liufu were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays; Yelü Shucheng, Zhao Cheng, Yelü Lie, and Zhang Dan were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year. On renxu day of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered that officials who privately took government goods be judged as common theft. Whoever dared to bring lawsuits citing cases already decided in former reigns was to be punished. Attendant langjun who hunted deer in forbidden grounds received three hundred strokes and were not assessed compensation; lesser generals received two hundred strokes or less; and commoners who violated were punished on the same terms as langjun. On bingxu day of the eighth month, because physician Deng Yanzhen's treatment of xiangwen Xiao Liuning's illness proved effective, his parents were granted official rank as reward. On xinhai day of the ninth month the Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager. Imperial maternal uncle Liuning died. On gengshen day the Empress Dowager shot and captured a bear, and the Emperor offered wine to wish her long life. On guihai day the Emperor hunted at Ma Meng Mountain; vegetation was thick and dense, and fearing hunters might accidentally shoot and injure people, he ordered Yelü Digu and the others each to write their names on their arrows for identification. On bingyin day Xia State presented Song captives. Because Shiying Stockade grand preceptor Guo San avoided a tiger and did not shoot, he was dismissed from office. On bingxu day of the tenth winter month an edict ordered Eastern Capital regent Xiao Xiaozhong to investigate officials who were incorruptible, capable, pure, and forceful, and report their names in full. On gengyin day Jurchen grand preceptor Taiya was made Great King of Yasus Guan. On xinmao day, because the imperial prince Hulu Woli was born, Northern Chancellor and imperial son-in-law Saba Ning welcomed the Emperor to his residence for feasting and drinking; the Emperor ordered guards and Han people to wrestle for amusement. On renchen day the court drank again in the Empress Dowager's hall; because an imperial prince had been born, a general amnesty was proclaimed. In the evening princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and inner-chamber ministers were summoned into the sleeping hall for heavy drinking again. On jiawu day the court visited the Central Capital. On gengzi day imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Hulie was appointed imperial maternal uncle xiangwen. On bingchen day of the eleventh month Uighur sent envoys with tribute. On the bingzi new moon of the twelfth month Song sent Liu Hong and Wang Zheng to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival. On yiwei day chiefs were established for the Tazhubu Gu tribe. Hu Talaci was appointed Associate Councilor of State. The Emperor heard that Song had fortified the passes and rivers and dug moats and feared it would become a border threat; with Southern and Northern Privy Commissioners Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu and Prince of Zhao Xiao Guanning he plotted to recover the ten Song counties south of the passes ceded in former times, and thereupon dispatched Xiao Ying and Liu Liufu as envoys to Song. On gengyin day Song sent Zhang Mian, Hou Zongliang, Xue Shen, Shi Qijun, Shi Changyan, and Pan Yongzhao to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival and New Year's Day of the coming year. Xuanzheng Hall academician Yang Jie was appointed Minister of Personnel and administrator of Shunyi Army military commissioner affairs. On dingyou day an attack on Song was discussed, and an edict ordered proclamation to all routes.

十一年春正月戊申，奉迎皇太后於內殿。庚戌，遣南院宣徽使蕭特末、翰林學士劉六符使宋，取晉陽及瓦橋以南十縣地；且問興師伐夏及沿邊疏浚水澤、增益兵戍之故。二月壬寅，如鴛鴦濼。夏四月甲戌朔，頒南征賞罰令。六月乙亥，宋遣富弼、張茂實奉書來聘，以書答之。壬午，禦含涼殿，放進士王寔等六十四人。禁氈、銀鬻入宋。秋七月壬寅朔，詔盜易官馬者減死論。外路官勤瘁正直者，考滿代；不治事者即易之。八月丙申，宋復遣富弼、張茂實奉書來聘，乞增歲幣銀絹，以書答之。九月壬寅，遣北院樞密副使耶律仁先、漢人行宮副部署劉六符使宋約和。是時，富弼為上言，大意謂遼與宋和，坐獲歲幣，則利在國家，臣下無與；與宋交兵，則利在臣下，害在國家。上感其言，和好始定。閏月癸未，耶律仁先遣人報，宋歲增銀、絹十萬兩、匹，文書稱貢，送至白溝；帝喜，宴群臣於昭慶殿。是日，振恤三父族之貧者。辛卯，仁先、劉六符還，進宋國誓書。冬十一月丁亥，群臣加上尊號曰聰文聖武英略神功睿哲仁孝皇帝，冊皇后蕭氏曰貞懿宣慈崇聖皇后。太赦。梁王洪基進封燕國王。十二月癸卯，朝皇太后。甲辰，封皇太弟重元子涅魯古為安定郡王。己酉，以宣獻皇后忌日，上與皇太后素服，飯僧於延壽、憫忠、三學三寺。辛亥，詔蠲預備伐宋諸部租稅一年。壬子，以吐渾、党項多鬻馬夏國，詔謹邊防。己未，宋遣賀正旦及永壽節使居邸，帝微服往觀。丁卯，禁喪葬殺牛馬及藏珍寶。

In the eleventh year, on wushen day of the first spring month the Empress Dowager was escorted into the inner hall. On gengxu day Southern Court commissioner of the palace secretariat Xiao Teme and Hanlin Academician Liu Liufu were dispatched as envoys to Song to recover the ten counties south of Jinyang and Waqiao; and also to inquire into the reasons for mobilizing troops against Xia and dredging border marshes and increasing military garrisons. On renyin day of the second month the court went to Yuanyang Marsh. On the jiaxu new moon of the fourth summer month reward-and-punishment regulations for the southern campaign were promulgated. On yihai day of the sixth month Song sent Fu Bi and Zhang Maoshi bearing letters on a goodwill mission, and a letter was sent in reply. On renwu day the court presided at Hailiang Hall and released jinshi Wang Shi and sixty-four others. The sale of felt and silver into Song was forbidden. On the renyin new moon of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered that those who stole or swapped official horses receive reduced death sentences. Outside-route officials who were diligent and upright were replaced at term's end; those who did not handle affairs were replaced immediately. On bingshen day of the eighth month Song again sent Fu Bi and Zhang Maoshi bearing letters on a goodwill mission, requesting increased annual tribute in silver and silk, and a letter was sent in reply. On renyin day of the ninth month Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian and Han traveling palace deputy deployment director Liu Liufu were dispatched as envoys to Song to negotiate peace. At that time Fu Bi spoke to the Emperor, the general purport being that if Liao made peace with Song and passively received annual tribute, the benefit lay with the state and subordinates had no share; if Liao fought Song, the benefit lay with subordinates and the harm with the state. The Emperor was moved by his words, and friendly relations were finally settled. On guiwei day of the intercalary month Yelü Renxian dispatched a messenger reporting that Song's annual tribute was increased by one hundred thousand taels of silver and bolts of silk, the documents called it tribute, and it was delivered to Baigou; the Emperor was pleased and feasted ministers at Zhaozing Hall. That day relief was provided for the poor among the three paternal clans. On xinmao day Renxian and Liu Liufu returned and presented the Song State oath document. On dinghai day of the eleventh winter month ministers added the honorific title Sagacious Cultured, Sagacious Martial, Heroic Strategist, Divine Merit, Wise Sage, Benevolent Filial Emperor, and invested Empress Xiao as Chaste Virtuous, Proclaiming Benevolence, Exalted Sage Empress. A general amnesty was proclaimed. Prince of Liang Hongji was advanced to Prince of Yan. On guimao day of the twelfth month the Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager. On jiachen day Imperial Grand Younger Brother Chongyuan's son Nielugu was enfeoffed as Duke of Anding Commandery. On jiyou day, because it was Empress Xuanxian's death anniversary, the Emperor and Empress Dowager wore plain dress and fed monks at Yanshou, Minzhong, and Sanxue temples. On xinhai day an edict remitted one year's rent and tax for tribes that had prepared to attack Song. On renzi day, because the Tuyuhun and Tangut frequently sold horses to Xia State, an edict ordered strict border defense. On jiwei day Song envoys congratulating on New Year's Day and the Eternal Longevity Festival were staying at their lodgings, and the Emperor went in disguise to observe them. On dingmao day killing cattle and horses at funerals and hoarding precious treasures were forbidden.

十二年春正月辛未，遣同知析津府事耶律敵烈、樞密院都承旨王惟吉諭夏國與宋和。壬申，以吳國王蕭孝穆為南院樞密使，北府宰相蕭孝忠北院樞密使，封楚王，韓國王蕭惠北府宰相、同知元帥府事，韓八南院大王，耶律侯哂東京留守，北院樞密副使耶律仁先同知東京留守事，北面林牙蕭革北院樞密副使。甲戌，如武清寨葦澱。二月壬寅，禁關南漢民弓矢。己酉，夏國以加上尊號，遣使來賀。甲寅，耶律敵烈等使夏國還，奏元昊罷兵，即遣使報宋。三月辛卯，幸南京。壬辰，高麗國以加上尊號，遣使來賀。夏四月己亥，置回跋部詳穩、都監。庚子，夏國遣使進馬、駝。五月辛卯，斡魯、蒲盧毛朵部二使來貢失期，宥而遣還。乙未，詔復定禮制。是月，幸山西。六月丙午，詔世選宰相、節度使族屬及身為節度使之家，許葬用銀器；仍禁殺牲以祭。庚戌，詔漢人宮分戶絕，恒產以親族繼之。辛亥，阻卜大王屯禿古斯弟太尉撒葛裏來朝。丙辰，回鶻遣使來貢。甲子，以南院樞密使吳國王蕭孝穆為北院樞密使，徙封齊國王。秋七月丙寅朔，北院樞密使蕭孝忠薨，特釋系囚。庚寅，夏國遣使上表，請伐宋，不從。八月丙申，謁慶陵。辛，燕國王洪基加尚書令，知北南院樞密使事，進封燕趙國王。戊午，以前西北路招討使蕭塔烈葛為右夷離畢。庚申，於越耶律洪古薨。甲子，阻卜來貢。九月壬申，朝皇太后，謁望仙殿。壬午，謁懷陵。冬十月丁酉，駐蹕中會川。己亥，北院樞密使蕭孝穆薨，追贈大丞相、晉國王。庚子，詔諸路上重囚，遣官詳讞。辛亥，參知政事韓紹芳為廣德軍節度使，三司使劉六符長寧軍節度使。壬子，以夏人侵党項，遣延昌宮使高家奴讓之。甲子，北府宰相蕭惠為北院樞密使，豳王遂哥為惕隱，惕隱敵魯古封漆水郡王、西北路招討使，樞密副使蕭阿剌同知北院宣徽事。出飛龍廄馬，分賜群臣。十一月丁丑，追封楚王蕭孝忠為楚國王。丁亥，以上京歲儉，復其民租稅。癸巳，朝皇太后。十二月戊申，改政事省為中書省。

In the twelfth year, on xinwei day of the first spring month Co-administrator of Xijin Prefecture Yelü Dilie and Privy Council chief director Wang Weiji were dispatched to instruct Xia State to make peace with Song. On renshen day Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu was appointed Southern Privy Commissioner; Northern Chancellor Xiao Xiaozhong was made Northern Privy Commissioner and enfeoffed as Prince of Chu; Prince of Han Xiao Hui was made Northern Chancellor and co-administrator of the marshal headquarters; Han Ba was made Southern Court great king; Yelü Houshen was appointed Eastern Capital regent; Northern Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Renxian was made co-administrator of Eastern Capital regent affairs; and Northern Court linya Xiao Ge was appointed Northern Privy Vice Commissioner. On jiaxu day the court went to Wuqing Stockade Reed Marsh. On renyin day of the second month Han commoners south of the passes were forbidden from possessing bows and arrows. On jiyou day Xia State, because of the added honorific title, sent envoys to congratulate. On jiayin day Yelü Dilie and others returned from their mission to Xia State and reported that Yuanhao had ceased hostilities; envoys were immediately dispatched to inform Song. On xinmao day of the third month the court visited the Southern Capital. On renchen day Goryeo, because of the added honorific title, sent envoys to congratulate. On jihai day of the fourth summer month xiangwen and chief superintendent were established for the Huiba tribe. On gengzi day Xia State sent envoys presenting horses and camels. On xinmao day of the fifth month two envoys of the Wolu and Pulu Modu tribes came with tribute late; they were pardoned and sent back. On yiwei day an edict restored and fixed the ritual regulations. That month the court visited the western mountains. On bingwu day of the sixth month an edict ordered that families of imperial-select chancellors and military commissioners and those who were themselves military commissioners be permitted burial goods of silver; slaughtering livestock for sacrifice was still forbidden. On gengxu day an edict ordered that when Han palace allotment households died out, fixed property was to pass to relatives. On xinhai day Zubu great king Tuntu Gusi's younger brother Grand Commandant Sage Li came to court. On bingchen day Uighur sent envoys with tribute. On jiazi day Southern Privy Commissioner Prince of Wu Xiao Xiaomu was appointed Northern Privy Commissioner and transferred in enfeoffment to Prince of Qi. On the bingyin new moon of the seventh autumn month Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Xiaozhong died, and prisoners in custody were specially released. On gengyin day Xia State sent envoys with a memorial requesting to attack Song; approval was not granted. On bingshen day of the eighth month the court visited Qing Mausoleum. On xin day Prince of Yan Hongji was additionally made Director of the Department of State Affairs, administering Northern and Southern Privy Commissioner affairs, and advanced to Prince of Yan and Zhao. On wuwu day former Northwest Route campaign commissioner Xiao Taliege was appointed Right yilibi. On gengshen day yueye Yelü Honggu died. On jiazi day Zubu came with tribute. On renshen day of the ninth month the Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager and visited Wangxian Hall. On renwu day the court visited Huai Mausoleum. On dingyou day of the tenth winter month the court encamped at Zhonghui River. On jihai day Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Xiaomu died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Chancellor and Prince of Jin. On gengzi day an edict ordered serious prisoners on all routes to have officials conduct detailed review. On xinhai day Associate Councilor Han Shaofang was appointed Guangde Army military commissioner, and Three Departments commissioner Liu Liufu was appointed Changning Army military commissioner. On renzi day, because Xia people had encroached on the Tangut, Yanchang Palace envoy Gao Jianu was dispatched to rebuke them. On jiazi day Northern Chancellor Xiao Hui was appointed Northern Court Privy Commissioner; Prince of Bin Suige was made tiyin; tiyin Dirugu was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui and Northwestern Route pacification commissioner; and Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ala was appointed concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner. Flying Dragon stable horses were brought out and distributed among the ministers. On dingchou day of the eleventh month Prince of Chu Xiao Xiaozhong was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Chu. On dinghai day, because the Upper Capital had a poor harvest, the people's land taxes were restored. On guisi day the court paid respects to the Empress Dowager. On wushen day of the twelfth month the Political Affairs Department was renamed the Zhongshu Department.

十三年春正月甲子朔，朝皇太后。戊辰，如混同江。辛未，獵兀魯館岡。二月庚戌，如魚兒濼。丙辰，以參知政事杜防為南府宰相。三月丁亥，高麗遣使來貢。以宣政殿學士楊佶參知政事。是月，置契丹警巡院。夏四月己酉，遣東京留守耶律侯哂、知黃龍府事耶律歐裏斯將兵攻蒲盧毛朵部。甲寅，南院大王耶律高十奏党項等部叛附夏國。丙辰，西南面招討都監羅漢奴、詳穩斡魯母等奏，山西部族節度使屈烈以五部叛入西夏，乞南、北府兵援送實威塞州戶。詔富者遣行，余留屯田天德軍。五月壬戌朔，羅漢奴奏所發部兵與党項戰不利，招討使蕭普達、四捷軍詳穩張佛奴歿於陣。李元昊來援叛黨。戊辰，詔征諸道兵會西南邊以討元昊。六月甲午，阻卜酋長烏八遣其子執元昊所遣求援使窊邑改來，乞以兵助戰，從之。駐蹕永安山。以將伐夏，遣延昌宮使耶律高家奴告宋。丙申，詔前南院大王耶律谷欲、翰林都林牙耶律庶成等編集國朝上世以來事跡。丙午，高麗遣使來貢。丁未，錄囚。秋七月辛酉，香河縣民李宜兒以左道惑眾，伏誅。庚午，行再生禮。庚辰，夏國遣使來朝。八月乙未，以夏使對不以情，羈之。丁巳，夏國復遣使來，詢以事宜，又不以實對，笞之。九月戊辰，宋以親征夏國，遣余靖致贐禮。壬申，會大軍於九十九泉，以皇太弟重元、北院樞密使韓國王蕭惠將先鋒兵西征。冬十月庚寅，祭天地。丙申，獲党項偵人，射鬼箭。丁酉，李元昊上表謝罪。己亥，元昊遣使來奏，欲收叛黨以獻，從之。辛亥，元昊遣使來進方物，詔北院樞密副使蕭革迓之。壬子，軍於河曲。革言元昊親率党項三部來，詔革詰其納叛背盟，元昊伏罪，賜酒。許以自新，遣之。召群臣議，皆以大軍既集，宜加討伐。癸丑，督數路兵掩襲，殺數千人，駙馬都尉蕭胡睹為夏人所執。丁巳，元昊遣使以先被執者來歸，詔所留夏使亦還其國。十一月辛酉，賜有功將校有差。甲子，班師。丁卯，改雲州為西京。辛巳，朝皇太后。十二月己丑，幸西京。戊戌，以北院樞密副使耶律敵烈為右夷離畢。己亥，高麗遣使來貢。戊申，蕭胡睹自夏來歸。

In the thirteenth year, on the jiazi new moon of the first spring month, the court paid respects to the Empress Dowager. On wuchen day the court went to Huntong River. On xinwei day the court hunted at Wulu Pavilion Ridge. On gengxu day of the second month the court went to Yu'er Marsh. On bingchen day Associate Councilor Du Fang was appointed Southern Chancellor. On dinghai day of the third month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute. Xuanzheng Hall academician Yang Jie was appointed Associate Councilor. That month a Khitan patrol inspectorate was established. On jiyou day of the fourth summer month Eastern Capital regent Yelü Houshi and Huanglong Prefecture intendant Yelü Oulisi were dispatched to lead troops against the Puluhu Modu tribe. On jiayin day Southern Court great king Yelü Gaoshi memorialized that Tangut and other tribes had rebelled and submitted to Xia State. On bingchen day Southwestern Route pacification inspector Luohan Nu, xiangwen Wulumu, and others memorialized that Western Mountain tribal military commissioner Qulie had led five tribes in rebellion into Western Xia and requested Northern and Southern Court troops to aid in escorting Shiwei Saizhou households. An edict ordered the wealthy to go; the remainder were to stay and farm at Tiande Army. On the renxu new moon of the fifth month Luohan Nu memorialized that dispatched tribal troops had fought Tangut unfavorably; pacification commissioner Xiao Puda and Sijie Army xiangwen Zhang Fonu died in battle. Li Yuanhao came to aid the rebels. On wuchen day an edict ordered troops from all routes mustered to assemble on the southwestern border to attack Yuanhao. On jiawu day of the sixth month Zubu chieftain Wuba sent his son with Yuanhao's dispatched envoy seeking aid, Woyigai, whom he had seized, requesting troops to aid in battle; approval was granted. The court halted at Yong'an Mountain. Because the court was about to attack Xia, Yongchang Palace commissioner Yelü Gao Jianu was dispatched to inform Song. On bingshen day an edict ordered former Southern Court great king Yelü Guyu, Hanlin Chief Linya Yelü Zhucheng, and others to compile court records from the founding to the present. On bingwu day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute. On dingwei day prisoners were reviewed. On xinyou day of the seventh autumn month Xianghe county man Li Yier was executed for leading the people astray by heterodox practices. On gengwu day the rebirth rite was performed. On gengchen day Xia State sent envoys to court. On yiwei day of the eighth month, because the Xia envoy answered without sincerity, he was detained. On dingsi day Xia State again sent envoys; when questioned on affairs they again answered untruthfully and were flogged. On wuchen day of the ninth month, because Song was personally campaigning against Xia State, Yu Jing was dispatched with funeral gifts. On renshen day the great army assembled at Ninety-nine Springs; Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan and Northern Court Privy Commissioner King of Han Xiao Hui commanded vanguard troops on a western expedition. On gengyin day of the tenth winter month sacrifices were offered to Heaven and Earth. On bingshen day Tangut scouts were captured and ghost arrows were shot. On dingyou day Li Yuanhao submitted a memorial begging forgiveness. On jihai day Yuanhao sent envoys memorializing that he wished to take back the rebels and present them; approval was granted. On xinchou day Yuanhao sent envoys presenting local products; an edict ordered Northern Court Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ge to meet them. On renzi day the army encamped at River Bend. Xiao Ge reported that Yuanhao was personally leading three Tangut tribes; an edict ordered Ge to reproach him for accepting rebels and breaking the alliance; Yuanhao acknowledged guilt and was granted wine. He was permitted to reform and was dispatched. The ministers were summoned for deliberation; all held that with the great army already assembled, attack should be pressed. On guichou day troops of several routes were urged in a surprise raid, killing several thousand; imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Hudu was captured by Xia. On dingsi day Yuanhao sent envoys returning those previously captured; an edict ordered detained Xia envoys also returned to their state. On xinyou day of the eleventh month meritorious officers and soldiers were rewarded in differing amounts. On jiazi day the army withdrew. On dingmao day Yun Prefecture was renamed Western Capital. On xinsi day the court paid respects to the Empress Dowager. On jichou day of the twelfth month the court visited Western Capital. On wuxu day Northern Court Privy Vice Commissioner Yelü Dilie was appointed right yilibi. On jihai day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute. On wushen day Xiao Hudu returned from Xia.

十四年春正月庚申，以侍中蕭虛烈為南院統軍使，封遼西郡王。庚午，如鴛鴦濼。壬午，以金吾衛大將軍敵魯古為乙室大王。甲申，夏國遣使進鶻。以常侍斡古得戰歿，命其子習羅為帥。二月庚子，朝皇太后。駐蹕撒剌濼。三月己卯，宋以伐夏師還，遣使來賀。四月辛亥，高麗遣使來貢。閏五月癸丑，清暑永安山。六月丁卯，謁慶陵。己卯，阻卜大王屯禿古斯率諸酋長來朝。庚辰，夏國遣使來貢。辛巳，以西南面招討使蕭普達戰歿，贈同中書門下平章事。秋七月戊申，駐蹕中會川。冬十月甲子，望祀木葉山。十一月壬午朔，回鶻阿薩蘭遣使來貢。甲辰，以同知北院宣徽事蕭阿剌為北府宰相。十二月癸丑，觀漢軍習炮射擊刺。癸亥，決滯獄。

In the fourteenth year, on gengshen day of the first spring month, Palace Attendant Xiao Xulie was appointed Southern Court army commander and enfeoffed Prince of Liaoxi. On gengwu day the court went to Yu'er Marsh. On renwu day Jinwu Guard senior general Dirugu was appointed Yishi great king. On jiashen day Xia State sent envoys presenting cranes. Because changshi Wogude had died in battle, his son Xiluo was appointed commander. On gengzi day of the second month the court paid respects to the Empress Dowager. The court halted at Sala Marsh. On jimao day of the third month, because Song's Xia campaign army had returned, envoys were dispatched to congratulate. On xinchou day of the fourth month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute. On guichou day of the intercalary fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain. On dingmao day of the sixth month the court visited Qing Mausoleum. On jimao day Zubu great king Tuntugusi led chieftains to court. On gengchen day Xia State sent envoys with tribute. On xinsi day, because Southwestern Route pacification commissioner Xiao Puda had died in battle, he was posthumously granted Associate Chief Councillor of the Central Secretariat. On wushen day of the seventh autumn month the court halted at Zhonghui River. On jiazi day of the tenth winter month distant sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye. On the renwu new moon of the eleventh month Uyghur Asalan sent envoys with tribute. On jiachen day concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner Xiao Ala was appointed Northern Chancellor. On guichou day of the twelfth month Han troops were observed drilling with artillery, crossbows, shooting, and thrusting. On guihai day stagnant lawsuits were cleared.
